About the role

The AI & Agentic Innovation – Project Manager will coordinate across the various agentic pilots developed by the Incubation Team and support the transition from the incubation phase to the scaling phase. This role involves overseeing the delivery of multiple pilots, structuring learnings and outcomes into an agentic development framework, and ensuring a smooth transition to scaling. It includes close collaboration with business and digital SMEs, functions across GBUs, markets, and external innovation partners.

What you’ll be doing
Oversee the execution of agent incubation pilots across GBUs and markets, from ideation to implementation. Create a consolidated view of ongoing initiatives and facilitate timely delivery within scope and budget.
Consolidate insights, best practices, and learnings across pilots. Maintain comprehensive documentation of outcomes to inform a reusable agent development framework.
The expected deliverable is an agent template for each pilot, including functional scope, business value, user experiences, business case, technical prerequisites and potential customizations, change management, legal, security, and responsible AI considerations.
Ensure effective knowledge sharing across GBUs and markets, between pilots, and with the scaling team.
Educate stakeholders and ITD teams on emerging AI and agentic technologies, innovation methodologies, and their potential impact on business, fostering a culture of experimentation and adoption while managing expectations.
Collaborate with business and digital SMEs and ITD across business units, countries, and functions to collect use cases, identify AI capabilities, share updates, and communicate learnings from the Incubation Team’s roadmap. Participate in Responsible AI governance related to agentic systems.
Coordinate with external innovation partners to leverage their expertise and resources in developing cutting-edge solutions.
About you
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Business, or a related field.
Knowledge or familiarity with innovation management frameworks and methodologies.
Proven experience in Innovation, developing PoCs and experimenting with new technologies, with a track record of successful project delivery.
Understanding of AI technologies, machine learning, and agentic systems is appreciated.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively with diverse stakeholders.
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Expertise in assessing the value and impact of innovation opportunities, including cost-benefit analysis and scalability potential.
Why choose us?

It’s an exciting time to be part of our team. At the Adecco Group, our purpose – making the future work for everyone – inspires and connects us all. Through our three global business units (GBU) – Adecco, Akkodis and LHH - we deliver expertise in talent and technology, enabling organizations to succeed and people to thrive.

We’re proud to be a global thought-leader and care about doing the best job we can to ensure better futures for everyone. We do this by building our Future@Work strategy as a united team of 30,000+ colleagues with a collective spirit working in over 60 countries globally. We embody our core values: Courage, Collaboration, Customer at the Heart, Inclusion, and Passion in everything we do.

Growth and Development

You will have the opportunity to grow across a variety of interesting jobs and careers over our extensive portfolio of global brands. We empower our colleagues to work in the smartest, most efficient ways, achieving total balance between their jobs and their lives. We offer world-class resources for upskilling and development, satisfying your curiosity while sharing skills, knowledge, and expertise to grow together. Here, you can be yourself, and we aim to build on the attributes that make you, you.

A journey to bring out the best in you

We believe that having an understanding of the hiring process helps you to prepare, feel, and be, at your best. As a global, multi brand organization with multiple different roles, our application process can vary.

On our career site, you will find some of the key steps you can expect to guide you along the way.

Inclusion

We believe in talent, not labels. We focus on the diverse and unique skills our people bring. Our culture of belonging and purpose ensures everyone can thrive and feel engaged. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to equity, equal opportunity, inclusion, and diversity.

Interview Process

Our interview process includes an initial phone screening, followed by a virtual round of interviews with Hiring Manager, HR team and senior leaders. This process helps us understand your fit within our team and allows you to ask questions about the role and our company. If you are a visionary leader with a passion for learning and development, we invite you to join us in making the future work for everyone.

Accommodations

We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment process for all candidates. If you require any additional accommodations or support due to a disability or other special circumstances, please let us know by contacting us. We will work with you to ensure your needs are met throughout the hiring process.

description:
Tätigkeitsbereich

Das KI-Labor bündelt KI-Expertise und KI-Talente in einer zentralen Einheit in der Stabsstelle Digitalstrategie und digitale Transformation. Als Expertenteam für KI und Anwendungsfall-Fabrik bringen wir KI in die DRV Bund und stehen allen Fachabteilungen als Ansprechpartner*in mit unserem Unterstützungs- und Beratungsangebot zur Seite. In einem stetig wachsenden interdisziplinären Team liefern wir mit Hilfe von KI-Technologien neue Lösungsansätze und leisten so Pionierarbeit für die zahlreichen Herausforderungen einer Bundesbehörde mit mehr als 26.000 Mitarbeitenden.

Ihre Aufgaben
Verantwortliches Konzeptionieren, Entwickeln und Implementieren von Data Science-Anwendungen mit Fokus auf GenAI und LLMs (Large Language Models) in crossfunktionalen Teams
Durchführen komplexer Modellierungsarbeiten im Bereich des maschinellen Lernens (zum Beispiel Random Forest, Gradient Boosting) und im Kontext von Large Language Modellen und deren Fine-Tuning
Visualisieren und Analysieren großer Datenmengen zur Detektion von Bias oder Daten-Drifts und zur Sicherstellung der Datenqualität
Konzeption, Entwicklung und Validierung hochkomplexer Machine Learning- und statistischer Modelle für anspruchsvolle Anwendungsfälle
Evaluation und Einführung neuer State-of-the-Art-Algorithmen und Technologien, inklusive Deep Learning und NLP (Natural Language Processing)
Strategisches und fachliches Mitgestalten der hausweiten Technologielandschaft zur Weiterentwicklung in eine KI-versierte Organisation
Mentoring von Junioren und Mid-Level Data Scientists sowie klare Kommunikation komplexer Ergebnisse an alle Stakeholder
Ihr Profil
Abgeschlossene wissenschaftliche Hochschulbildung (Master, Diplom oder gleichartiger Abschluss) mit quantitativem Schwerpunkt; idealerweise der Studienrichtung MINT (Mathematik, Informatik, Naturwissenschaften oder Technik) oder der Sozial- beziehungsweise Wirtschaftswissenschaften
Mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Erstellung von ML-Methoden (Machine Learning) und der Modellierung komplexer automatisierter KI-Systeme, davon mindestens drei Jahre als Data Scientist
Nachweisbare Projekterfahrungen mit agilen Vorgehensmodellen (zum Beispiel Scrum) und mindestens einem KI-Referenzprojekt
Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in Python inklusive gängiger Machine Learning Frameworks (zum Beispiel scikit-learn, PyTorch) und Umgang mit Advanced Analytics Technologien / Tools
Umfassende Kenntnisse in fortgeschrittenen statistischen Methoden und kausaler Inferenz, sowie nachgewiesene Expertise in verschiedenen ML-Algorithmen, inklusive GenAI
Erfahrung in der Konzeption, Entwicklung und Optimierung von RAG-Modellen (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) sowie der Auswahl und Anpassung von LLMs für domänenspezifische Anwendungsfälle
Kenntnisse von Datenbankmanagementsystemen, Containertechnologien (zum Beispiel Kubernetes) und deren Zusammenspiel mit klassischen Datenbankumgebungen
Erfahrung mit Cloud-Plattformen (zum Beispiel AWS, Azure) und deren Data / ML-Services (zum Beispiel SageMaker, Azure ML)
Proaktives Kommunikationsverhalten, ausgeprägte Kooperationsbereitschaft und vernetztes Denken in der agilen Zusammenarbeit runden Ihr Profil ab
Wir bieten Ihnen
Wir bieten Ihnen eine interessante und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit allen Vorteilen einer großen öffentlichen Arbeitgeberin
Die Möglichkeit durch eigene Ideen die digitale Transformation der DRV Bund mitzugestalten
Vielfältige Projekte wie KIRA, in dem eine KI-basierte Anwendung für unseren Betriebsprüfdienst entwickelt wird
Individuelle Fortbildungsmöglichkeiten, vielseitige Schulungsangebote und die Teilnahme an Fachkonferenzen fördern fachliches Wachstum sowie Communities of Practice (CoP) unterstützen den kontinuierlichen Wissensaustausch
Eine hervorragende Aussicht aus dem 16. Stock des Silberturms über den Dächern Berlins am Hohenzollerndamm
Vereinbarkeit von Familie und Beruf durch flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle sowie der Möglichkeit der Arbeit im Homeoffice; mindestens zwei Tage Präsenz pro Woche
Familienservice: benefit@work für Eltern und Amiravita für pflegende Mitarbeiter*innen
Weitere Informationen

Zur Besetzung der Position werden wir mit Bewerbenden, die sich in der engeren Auswahl befinden, Gespräche führen. Bestandteil des Auswahlverfahrens wird eine Arbeitsprobe in Form einer Programmieraufgabe in Python sein.

Die Tätigkeit erfordert sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Vorteile
30 Urlaubstage bei 5-Tage-Woche
Jahressonderzahlungen und vermögenswirksame Leistungen
Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
Unbefristete Stelle
Gleitzeit

Tel.: 030 865-32263

Join us as a C++ Storage Engineer to build high-performance, scalable storage systems. Drive innovation in parallel storage, optimize algorithms, and shape the future of data infrastructure.

Exasol’s Analytics Engine accelerates insights from the world’s data. It is purpose-built to handle the most demanding data workloads at an unmatched price/performance ratio. Our in-memory, massively parallel processing (MPP) technology is specifically designed for analytics, enabling businesses to turn data into actionable insights.

At Exasol, we are committed to pushing the boundaries of what is possible in data analytics, and we are looking for enthusiastic individuals to join our team and help shape the future of data technology. Join our diverse, remote-first team where more than 30+ languages (and counting!) are spoken, and every voice is valued. We are looking for passionate individuals who thrive on collaboration, innovation, and a shared commitment to help shape the future of data technology.

Overview

We are seeking a C++ Storage Engineer that will be at the forefront of innovation, working hands-on with our cutting-edge parallel storage solution. You will design and implement advanced algorithms, collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate storage functionality, and stay abreast of the latest industry developments. Your expertise in C++, parallel storage technologies, and cloud platforms will be crucial in advancing our storage solutions to new heights.

Responsibilities
Further develop our massively parallel storage solution, ensuring it scales effectively to meet ever-growing data demands while maintaining peak efficiency.
Design and implement intricate algorithms that optimize data management, storage, and retrieval processes, ensuring consistent high performance.
Partner closely with other development teams to guarantee the smooth integration of storage-related functionalities, creating a unified and powerful system.
Leverage your experience of parallel storage technologies to provide valuable insights and drive innovation in our storage solution.
Stay informed on storage technology advancements, continuously learning and exploring new approaches to enhance our solutions.
Rigorously test, debug, and refine the codebase to ensure maximum stability and reliability of our storage solutions.
Required Qualifications
A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
5-7 years of relevant experience in software development, with a focus on storage systems, including experience in building robust, complex software products within a Massively Parallel Processing (MPP) environment.
Strong proficiency in modern C++ programming with a focus on performance optimization.
Familiarity with scripting languages such as Bash and Python for automation and streamlining tasks.
Solid understanding of Linux environments.
Knowledge of parallel storage technologies like HDFS, GlusterFS, Ceph, and RAID algorithms.
Familiarity with public cloud storage solutions across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
Proven expertise in creating efficient and distributed algorithms.
An analytical and structured approach to problem-solving, coupled with a commitment to high-quality code.
Approach challenges with a methodical and logical mindset.
Maintain a strong focus on delivering high-quality code and solutions.
Working proficiency in English.
How We Work at Exasol:
Own Your Impact: At Exasol, you are not just a cog in the machine; you will step into immediate ownership of projects, driving them forward with a refreshing level of autonomy.
Thrive in a Global Team: Join a vibrant, international community where diversity is celebrated, collaboration is key, and feedback fuels growth.
Learn, Grow, Lead: We are invested in your development! Continuous knowledge-sharing, "Coffee and Learn" sessions, exciting events, and dedicated leadership programs empower you to soar.
Work on Your Terms: Flexibility is the name of the game! Enjoy adaptable hours, remote options, and "workcations" for the ultimate work-life balance.
Growth That Goes Beyond the Office: Dive into a comprehensive onboarding experience, fun team events, and a deep commitment to diversity and sustainability. We care about your holistic well-being.
Rewards that Matter: Monthly home office allowance, volunteering options, floating days, and secure pension plans (location-dependent) prove we value your contributions.

Our values drive our unique and inclusive culture; discover how they shape your Exasol experience. Learn more about our core values at Exasol.

About Exasol:

Take the next step in your career journey. Visit www.exasol.com to explore our current job openings, and follow us on LinkedIn to see what it is like to work at Exasol.

Exasol is a proud equal opportunities employer. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive working environment and therefore base all our employment selection decisions, within all aspects of our business, on experience, skill, and integrity. We strongly encourage applicants from all walks to life to apply for our positions, irrespective of age, sex, gender identity, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion, etc.

  • Strong proficiency in modern C++ programming with a focus on performance optimization.
  • Familiarity with scripting languages such as Bash and Python for automation and streamlining tasks.
  • Solid understanding of Linux environments.
  • Knowledge of parallel storage technologies like HDFS, GlusterFS, Ceph, and RAID algorithms.

description:
WHAT'S THE ROLE?

Making our operations more digital is a key element of Hilti`s group strategy. Our department drives the digitalization program for our product base, supply, and product management processes. As working student in our department you’ll be part of Hilti`s global inhouse-consultancy team for product portfolio Management. You will be working in shaping data pipelines, developing and implementing data analytics and AI solutions for optimizing the management and utilization of engineering data of Hilti products.

Start date is flexible to the student's availability, duration for at least 6 - 9 months.
50% remote work is possible within Germany.

WHO IS HILTI?

Hilti is the place where innovation is harnessed to improve productivity, safety, and sustainability in the global construction industry and beyond. It's where solutions are born based on strong customer relationships, making it possible to build a better future. It's where 34,000 people across 120 different locations worldwide take pride in being part of the team. It's where people have the opportunity to explore their possibilities, unleash their potential, take responsibility for their personal development, and build their careers for the long term.
From the research of new technologies to the development of market-maturity, innovative system solutions in the field of fastening and fire protection - our products are tested and optimised with the most modern laboratory equipment.

WHAT DOES THE ROLE INVOLVE?

Collaborate closely with Product Development, Operational Excellence, Data Science, and IT teams to integrate advanced analytics into business processes
Manage and optimize data pipelines to ensure efficient and reliable data flow
Work with cross-functional teams to identify and implement innovative data-driven solutions
Lead initiatives to maintain data integrity and ensure security across all platforms
Provide technical support and guidance to team members on data-related issues

We attach great importance to professional development: around 80% of management positions are filled with internal candidates.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

SAP Software Engineer (m/w/d)

Messstellenbetreiber | IT-Lösungen und Beratung | SWM Services GmbH

Jetzt bewerben
Auf einen Blick

Die Stadtwerke München (SWM) als einer der größten kommunalen Versorgungs- und Dienstleistungsunternehmen in Deutschland bieten für die Stadt und die Region München eine breite Palette von Dienstleistungen und Versorgungsleistungen an, von der Energieversorgung über Verkehrsdienstleistungen bis hin zu Bädern und Freizeiteinrichtungen.

Als tragende Säule für digitale Innovation in unserer Versorgungswirtschaft suchen wir ab sofort einen erfahrenen und engagierten SAP Software Engineer (m/w/d).

Du übernimmst als Teil eines funktionsübergreifenden, agilen Teams die Ende-zu-Ende-Verantwortung für Konzeption, Umsetzung und Betrieb von SAP-Prozessen. Das Team arbeitet im Wesentlichen nach SCRUM und fungiert selbstorganisiert. Wir bieten ein angenehmes Arbeitsumfeld, eine aktive SAP community, den Einsatz moderner Technologien und flexible Arbeitszeiten.

Du kannst uns gerne mitteilen, mit welcher Wochenarbeitszeit du dir vorstellen kannst, bei uns zu arbeiten. Die Mindeststundenanzahl für die Position beträgt 32 Stunden pro Woche.

Tätigkeitsbereich

Informatik/Informationstechnologie

Einstiegsart

Berufsanfänger/Berufserfahrener (m/w/d)

Standort

München

Vertragsart

Vollzeit, unbefristet

Die Top-Benefits

Abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeiten

Beruf und Privatleben

Teamgeist und Zusammenhalt

Das kannst du bei uns bewegen
Du bringst eine end-to-end Perspektive auf Prozesse der Energiewirtschaft mit und entwickelst diese proaktiv und eigenständig.
Deine SAP ABAP-OO Erfahrung setzt du aktiv ein und gestaltest Prozesse und Entitäten nachhaltig. Dabei arbeitest du am Stand der Technik nach RAP-Modell, dem Konsum von CDS-Views mittels EML oder dem Umgang mit APE-Frameworks.
Du unterstützt bei Fehleranalysen, trägst zur stetigen Verbesserung unserer Fachprozesse bei und stellst einen erfolgreichen Entwicklungsprozess sicher.
Bei Problemstellungen und Abhängigkeiten initiierst du im Team Entscheidungen und Lösungen u.a. mit dem fachlichen Productowner, Solution Architect, Testkoordinator*in und anderen Entwickler*innen.
An PI Plannings nimmst du aktiv teil, um kundenorientierte Konzepte sowie passende technische Umsetzungslösungen zu definieren.
Durch Deine Expertise und einen frischen Blick trägst Du proaktiv zu der Verbesserung unserer Prozessarchitektur, Codequalität, Best Practices und Toolketten bei.
Schnittstellen zu deinen Entwicklungen stimmst du selbständig ab und hast dabei übergreifende Prozessketten im Blick.
Gemeinsam mit Lead und Solution Architects gestaltest du den Aufbau unserer Software-Architekturen und die Robustheit deiner Prozesse.
Damit überzeugst du uns
Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im IT-Bereich und langjährige Erfahrung in Softwareentwicklung und Softwaredesign oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung mit entsprechender Erfahrung.
Seit mehreren Jahren entwickelst du begeistert komplexe Softwaresysteme und Infrastrukturen, und hast Spaß daran neue Technologien zu erforschen, auszuprobieren und in Wirkung zu bringen.
Deine Stärke besteht darin, komplexe Problemstellungen strukturiert sowie kundenorientiert anzugehen sowie in einer ausgeprägten Analytik. Auch Prozessmodellierung (z.B. BPMN) ist dir nicht fremd.
Du bist es gewohnt, ein Produkt vom Design bis zum End-of-Life zu betreuen und dafür die Verantwortung zu tragen.
Neuen Methoden und Technologien (z.B. AI und Machine-Learning, SAP-Activate, Cloud-Integrationsszenarien, etc.) begegnest du mit Interesse und hast Freude an POCs und Integration.
Gerne agierst du als Gestalter*in im Team und scheust dich nicht vor der Zusammenarbeit mit mehreren unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern.
Du bist interessiert an aktuellen IT-Trends und beobachtest aktiv den Markt und die SAP-Entwicklungsszene.
Das bieten wir dir

Unsere Arbeitswelt

39-Stunden-Woche mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und Zeitkonto
30 Urlaubstage jährlich, sowie zusätzliche freie Tage am 24. und 31. Dezember
Intensives und vielfältiges Onboardingprogramm für einen reibungslosen Start
Langfristige Projekte mit hoher Arbeitsplatzsicherheit

Vergütung und Zusatzangebote

Zusatzleistungen: Betriebliche Altersvorsorge (7,75% des Jahresbruttoeinkommens), Vermögenswirksame Leistungen, Erfolgsbeteiligung
Vergünstigte Job-Tickets (IsarCard, Deutschlandticket) und attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte für JobRad und MVG-Rad
Attraktive Arbeitsstätte mit Fitnessstudio, Urban Sportsclub-Mitgliedschaft, bezuschusster Kantine und modernen Flächen

SWM Spezial

Möglichkeit zur Bewerbung auf eine von über 1300 werksgeförderten Mitarbeiterwohnungen
Exklusive Rabatte über unsere Benefits-App, Vergünstigungen auf Veranstaltungen, u.v.m.
Mitarbeitertarife für Strom oder Gas
Weitere Informationen

Wir sind DIGITALL – ein führendes Unternehmen in den Bereichen Digitale Transformation und Digitale Cloud Experience, entstanden aus zwei Technologieunternehmen mit mehr als 20 Jahren Erfolg auf dem globalen Markt. Mit vereinten Kräften bieten wir Unternehmen die nächste Generation der Digitalen Transformation & Digitalen Cloud Experience.

Wir digitalisieren und schützen Kunden, Mitarbeiter und Daten. Unsere Kunden vertrauen uns, dass wir ihre Kerngeschäftsprozesse sicher in die digitale Welt transformieren.

DIGITALL ist weltweit tätig und beschäftigt über 1.400 Mitarbeiter:innen in 25 Niederlassungen in 12 Ländern in Europa und Nordamerika.
Neben dem Aufbau eines wettbewerbsfähigen Portfolios hat unser Expert:innenteam starke Beziehungen zu strategischen Technologiepartnern aufgebaut, darunter Salesforce, Microsoft, IBM, SAP, Oracle, Cisco, Snowflake, Zuora usw.

Wir begleiten Unternehmen verschiedenster Industrien rund um ihre digitale Transformation, damit diese ihr Geschäft nachhaltig ausbauen können. Disruptive Zeiten haben die Notwendigkeit einer 360°-Transformation der Customer Journey und des Kundenerlebnisses erhöht, welche mit Hilfe von Künstlicher Intelligenz (KI) als zentralem Baustein erfolgt.

Die stetige Veränderung unserer Arbeitsweise und die Digitalisierung der Arbeitsplätze erfordern auch einen Wandel der Geschäftsmodelle und Kulturen. Wir ermöglichen unseren Kunden mit Hilfe von Direct-to-Consumer-Modellen sowie Abo-Modellen näher an ihren Kunden zu sein.

Mit KI-basierter Customer Intelligence und Cloud-basierten Technologien bieten wir unseren Kunden Customer Relationship Management (CRM) sowohl als Plattform als auch als strategisches Konzept für ein besseres Verständnis kundenzentrierter Prozesse und Kommunikation.

Darüber hinaus bieten wir Mitarbeitern intelligente, personalisierte Arbeitsplätze. Wir helfen unseren Kunden dabei, ihre Mitarbeitenden auf der ganzen Welt miteinander zu vernetzen und mobiles Arbeiten zu ermöglichen. Daneben können sie Künstliche Intelligenz für intelligentes Reporting und Prognosen nutzen.

At DIGITALL we don’t just deliver technology – we deliver the future! We are explorers, knowledge-hunters, tech geeks, problem solvers and game changers who want to inspire and be inspired. Our DIGITALL people are always one step forward: working with top-notch technologies, creating innovations ahead of the market trends, sharing the passion for discovering better ways.

As a human-centric organization, our teams are built on mutual respect and open communication, allowing everyone to be authentic, express ideas and unleash their potential. Design, develop, and maintain Python-based applications and solutions.
Develop and optimize data pipelines and ETL processes.
Uphold code quality and maintainability through best practices, including code reviews, unit testing, and comprehensive documentation.
Troubleshoot and resolve application and data-related issues.
Implement and manage cloud-based services and software infrastructure using Azure.
Stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends and technologies to ensure the continuous improvement of our solutions.

Hands-on experience with Azure services, such as Azure Functions, Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL Database, and/or Azure Blob Storage.
Strong understanding of relational databases.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
Knowledge of containerization technologies such as Podman or Docker.
OTHER QUALIFICATIONS
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Detail-oriented with a focus on delivering high-quality solutions.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.

Knowledge of machine learning and data science concepts.

description:
Cresta is on a mission to turn every customer conversation into a competitive advantage by unlocking the true potential of the contact center. Our platform combines the best of AI and human intelligence to help contact centers discover customer insights and behavioral best practices, automate conversations and inefficient processes, and empower every team member to work smarter and faster. Born from the prestigious Stanford AI lab, Cresta's co-founder and chairman is Sebastian Thrun, the genius behind Google X, Waymo, Udacity, and more. Our leadership also includes CEO, Ping Wu, the co-founder of Google Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platform.

We’ve assembled a world-class team of AI and ML experts, go-to-market leaders, and top-tier investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Greylock Partners, Sequoia, and former AT&T CEO John Donovan. Our valued customers include brands like Intuit, Cox Communications, Hilton, and Carmax and we’ve been recognized by Forbes and Bain Consulting as one of the top private AI companies in the world.

Join us on this thrilling journey to revolutionize the workforce with AI. The future of work is here, and it's at Cresta.

Role Overview:

As the Product Manager - Internationalization, you will spearhead the development and execution of our Internationalization and Languages strategy, and support our expansion into EMEA (and other markets). You will be pivotal in building out our multi-lingual AI capabilities and localizing our product. As such, this role blends true impact on Cresta’s growth with the opportunity to solve complex AI and user experience problems. So if you love a fast-paced environment and getting a product off the ground while working with some of the best engineers and GTM leads around - this is your chance to make a big impact.

Key Responsibilities:

Vision and Roadmap Development: Define and articulate the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Cresta’s internationalization, ensuring alignment with company objectives and market needs.
Market Research and Opportunity Identification: Conduct comprehensive market research and stakeholder discovery to identify and quantify opportunities expansion, in order to prioritize our investments.
Broad Product Expertise: Become and stay knowledgeable across the breadth of Cresta’s products to facilitate multi-lingual development across our suite
Cross-Functional Leadership: Lead and collaborate with engineering, design, sales, and customer success teams to drive the product development process from ideation to delivery. Facilitate effective communication and coordination across departments to ensure cohesive product strategies and successful launches.
Customer Engagement: Engage with prospects, customers and partners to not only gather feedback, but also help drive sales and customer satisfaction. This is where your broad product expertise will come in particular use - given that you are the primary product point of contact in EMEA.

Qualifications:

Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field. An advanced degree or MBA is preferred.
Professional Experience: A minimum of 6 years in product management roles within enterprise SaaS environments with 0-1 experience, focus on AI/ML-driven products related to knowledge management, enterprise search, or virtual agents. Proven experience in the contact center industry is highly desirable.
Technical Proficiency: In-depth understanding of AI technologies, machine learning applications, and agile development methodologies. Ability to engage with technical teams to drive product development effectively.
Leadership and Communication Skills: Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams, manage complex projects, and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Analytical and Problem-Solving Abilities: Strong analytical skills with the capacity to translate data into actionable insights. Proven problem-solving skills and a track record of making data-driven decisions.
Adaptability and Initiative: Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of getting things done independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Ability to adapt to changing market conditions, obstacles and drive innovation.

If you are a passionate and experienced Product Manager with a knack for tackling ambiguous problems with massive potential impact, and you're excited about working in the contact center space, we would love to hear from you. Apply now and join our dynamic team!

Compensation:

Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity, and a variety of benefits. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable. We are actively hiring for this role, and offer competitive local pay and benefits. Your recruiter can provide further details.

We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the @cresta.ai domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official Cresta employee, reach out to recruiting@cresta.ai

companyInfo/companyDescription:
Die Universität zu Köln ist eine der führenden Forschungsuniversitäten Deutschlands. Unser Anliegen ist es, das menschliche Wissen durch Grundlagenforschung voranzutreiben und dieses Wissen für die Gesellschaft verfügbar und nutzbar zu machen.
Wir legen größten Wert auf eine forschungsbasierte Lehre und eine Nachwuchsförderung, die akademische wie berufliche Karrieren eröffnet. Die Attraktivität unserer Universität als Studienort belegen die fast 50.000 Studierenden, denen über 335 Studiengänge zur Auswahl stehen.
Unsere Universität gehört zu den größten Arbeitgeber:innen Kölns. Gut 10.000 Mitarbeiter:innen in Wissenschaft, Technik und Verwaltung helfen bei der Erfüllung unseres Auftrages, für die Gesellschaft zu forschen und die nächsten Generationen auszubilden.
Als Arbeitgeberin stehen wir für die Förderung von Spitzenforschung durch die Schaffung individueller Freiräume, für Dynamik und Innovation durch Wissenstransfer und Unternehmensgründungen, für Chancengerechtigkeit, Diversität, Familienfreundlichkeit und Internationalisierung.
Wir haben Schwerpunkte auf sechs große, international kompetitive Forschungsbereiche gelegt: „Altersassoziierte Erkrankungen“, „Behavioral Economic Engineering and Social Cognition“, „Quantenmaterie- und materialien“, „Sozio-ökonomischer, kultureller und politischer Wandel im Globalen Süden“, „Pflanzenwissenschaften“ sowie „Skills and Structures in Language and Cognition“.
Junge Forschende werden in unseren 31 Graduiertenschulen gefördert und erfahren besondere Unterstützung durch das Albertus-Magnus-Center, der zentralen Informations-, Weiterbildungs- und Beratungsstelle für unsere Promotionsinteressierten sowie Doktorand:innen und Postdocs.
Unser Campus liegt im Herzen der Domstadt. Die vielbeschriebene Kölner Lebensfreude durchdringt auch die Universität und erleichtert das Ankommen und Einleben. In Köln, in der Region und im Ausland ist die Universität hervorragend vernetzt.

Ref. nummer: 2025/234The Department of Computer Science at Aalborg University has a fully-funded PhD position available. The candidate will be working on formal verification of neural-network control policies. The earliest starting date is September 1, 2025, but a later date can be negotiated.

The Department of Computer Science features a broad range of synergistic activities within research and education in the general area of computer science, including curiosity-driven research and targeted research in collaboration with industrial partners, traditional university education with a unique problem- and project-based focus, and continued education and knowledge dissemination.

Job description

The project addresses the fundamental question of how to trust a neural network that controls a dynamical system. Since neural networks are large black boxes, we need both automatic methods to analyze such systems and human-interpretable certificates of the analysis results. We will devise automatic and sound methods to respectively certify correctness and incorrectness of neural-network controllers. We will also develop a framework that integrates these methods for constructing correct-by-design controllers. Methodologically, we will investigate how traditional computer-science techniques for verification and falsification as well as machine learning can be tailored to these goals. This way, the project lays the grounds toward safe AI control systems.

The candidate will be part of the Distributed, Embedded and Distributed Systems research group: https://www.cs.aau.dk/research/distributed-embedded-intelligent-systems/

Applicants must have a Master’s degree in computer science or a closely related field such as mathematics or control engineering. Due to the project’s angle, applicants should have a strong background in at least one of the following areas: formal methods, machine learning. Additional knowledge and experience within the following areas are appreciated: formal verification, deep learning, dynamical systems, control theory. Excellent spoken and written communication skills in English are expected.

Application

An application must contain:

1. A cover letter of max. 2 pages (excl. references), including (i) motivation for applying, (ii) preferred starting date, and (iii) an explanation of the applicant’s background and suitability for the position
2. A CV
3. Diplomas and transcripts of records (both BSc and MSc)

Interested applicants are welcome to contact Associate Professor Christian Schilling (christianms@cs.aau.dk) regarding the scientific aspects of the position.

PhD stipends are allocated, normally for a period of 3 years, to individuals who hold a Master's degree. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Technical Doctoral School of IT and Design in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 1039 of August 27, 2013 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time.

For further information about stipends and salary as well as practical issues concerning the application procedure, please contact Ms. Annemarie Davidsen, the Doctoral School at The Technical Faculty of IT and Design, email: ada@adm.aau.dk.

Do you have any questions?

If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Read more about The Technical Doctoral School of IT and Design

Further information

We recommend that you save a copy of the job posting, as it will be removed once the application deadline has passed.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.
Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

The application is only to be submitted online by using the "Apply online" button below.

AAU wishes to reflect the diversity of society and welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background or belief.

The Department of Computer Science at Aalborg University has a fully-funded PhD position available. The candidate will be working on formal verification of neural-network control policies. The earliest starting date is September 1, 2025, but a later date can be negotiated.

The Department of Computer Science features a broad range of synergistic activities within research and education in the general area of computer science, including curiosity-driven research and targeted research in collaboration with industrial partners, traditional university education with a unique problem- and project-based focus, and continued education and knowledge dissemination.

Job description

The project addresses the fundamental question of how to trust a neural network that controls a dynamical system. Since neural networks are large black boxes, we need both automatic methods to analyze such systems and human-interpretable certificates of the analysis results. We will devise automatic and sound methods to respectively certify correctness and incorrectness of neural-network controllers. We will also develop a framework that integrates these methods for constructing correct-by-design controllers. Methodologically, we will investigate how traditional computer-science techniques for verification and falsification as well as machine learning can be tailored to these goals. This way, the project lays the grounds toward safe AI control systems.

The candidate will be part of the Distributed, Embedded and Distributed Systems research group: https://www.cs.aau.dk/research/distributed-embedded-intelligent-systems/

Applicants must have a Master’s degree in computer science or a closely related field such as mathematics or control engineering. companyInfo/companyDescription: BIOTRONIK, an international company with German roots, develops and manufactures life-saving and life-improving medical devices in the field of heart rhythm management and vascular intervention. In the field of cardiac rhythm therapy, the core products are system solutions for implantable defibrillators, resynchronization therapy implants, cardiac pacemakers, injectable monitoring implants and electrophysiology applications. With the award-winning BIOTRONIK Home Monitoring® Service, a pioneering achievement in the field of healthcare digitization, implant patients can be remotely cared for by their physician worldwide and at any time. Hundreds of thousands of implants are already sending daily and automatically information about the condition of the heart and the implant to the Home Monitoring Service Center (HMSC), which analyzes, filters and prepares the data for the treating physician. In the field of vascular intervention, BIOTRONIK manufactures stents, scaffolds and catheter systems for use in the coronary and peripheral areas. The company is also a pioneer in this field: in 2016, the world's first fully absorbable scaffold based on a magnesium alloy was approved and launched on the market. The company is privately held.

Senior Data Scientist / Research Engineer for Biomedical Signal Processing (m/f/d))

BIOTRONIK is one of the leading manufacturers of cardio- and endovascular implants and catheters for cardiac rhythm management, electrophysiology and vascular intervention. As a globally active company headquartered in Berlin, Germany, we develop, produce and distribute high-quality medical products based on the latest technology and research. Our success is based on the competence and results-oriented cooperation of our employees.

About Us

We're an innovative team within BIOTRONIK working at the cutting edge of digital health diagnostics. While we maintain the agile, informal atmosphere of a startup, we offer the stability and benefits of an established medical technology company. Our mission is to transform modern sensor technology into powerful medical diagnostic tools, making healthcare more accessible and convenient for patients worldwide.

Role Overview

We're seeking an experienced Data Scientist / Research Engineer to develop and validate sophisticated signal processing algorithms which convert multi-sensor data into precise cardiovascular measurements. This role combines signal processing expertise, data analysis, machine learning and algorithm development in a unique medical technology context. You'll work closely with medical professionals to ensure our algorithms capture clinically relevant parameters with the required precision.

Design and implement novel signal processing algorithms for extracting medical parameters from various sensor inputs
Analyze and validate algorithm performance using clinical study data
Compare results against medical gold standards and optimize algorithm accuracy
Translate medical requirements into technical specifications for algorithm development
Prototype solutions using Python/NumPy and support translation to production C++ code
Collaborate with our clinical validation team to interpret study results
Work with medical professionals to understand clinical requirements and validate algorithm outputs
Document technical approaches and research findings
Stay current with relevant scientific literature and emerging techniques in signal processing and machine learning

Required Qualifications

Master's or PhD in Signal Processing, Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field
Strong foundation in signal processing and filtering techniques
Knowledge of machine learning techniques and their practical applications
Proven experience analyzing experimental data and deriving meaningful insights
Strong statistical analysis skills
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
Proficiency in Python and scientific computing libraries (NumPy, SciPy, etc.)
Strong communication skills and ability to explain complex concepts clearly
Multiple years of prior experience working on relevant topics in a self-managed manner

Some familiarity with medical device regulations (CE, FDA)
Background in medical or physiological data analysis
Experience with clinical studies or medical research
Publication record in relevant fields

Innovative work environment combining startup agility with corporate stability

Professional development opportunities

  • Prototype solutions using Python/NumPy and support translation to production C++ code
  • Collaborate with our clinical validation team to interpret study results
  • Work with medical professionals to understand clinical requirements and validate algorithm outputs
  • Document technical approaches and research findings
  • Stay current with relevant scientific literature and emerging techniques in signal processing and machine learning

Required Qualifications

  • Knowledge of machine learning techniques and their practical applications

  • Strong statistical analysis skills
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Proficiency in Python and scientific computing libraries (NumPy, SciPy, etc.)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to explain complex concepts clearly

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with C++ development
  • Some familiarity with medical device regulations (CE, FDA)
  • Background in medical or physiological data analysis
  • Experience with clinical studies or medical research
  • Publication record in relevant fields

What We Offer

  • Modern, well-equipped office in a prime location

  • Collaborative, informal team culture

Senior OCR Developer (f/m/x)

Country: Germany

Santander Consumer Technology Services GmbH is a subsidiary of Santander Consumer Bank AG in Germany. At our location in Mönchengladbach, we work on both national and international projects. As professional integrators with the best qualifications in the field of development and implementation of banking software, we offer Santander competitive project management and professional services with a strong focus on quality and time-to-market.

Your Tasks

Development and maintenance of backend applications using Spring Boot

Design and implementation of RESTful APIs for OCR data workflows

Fine-tuning and optimization of OCR models using Amazon Textract

Deployment and management of services in Kubernetes environments

Integration of MongoDB for document storage and retrieval

Application of Machine Learning, Computer Vision and Image Processing techniques to enhance OCR performance

Collaboration with internal teams to align technical solutions with business needs

Living a risk culture by continuously developing and maintaining a sense of responsibility in the proactive handling of risks within Santander Germany.

Your Profile

Successfully completed university degree in (business) computer science, information systems or alternatively a solid education and relevant experience

Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in OCR technologies and backend development preferably in the financial sector

Extensive and in-depth knowledge in the fields of OCR , Machine Learning , Computer Vision , Image Processing and Data Engineering

Expert knowledge in Amazon Textract

Solid programming skills with Java & Python

Experience with the key technologies Spring Boot , MongoDB , Kubernetes and REST APIs

Experience with AWS services (e.g., S3, Lambda, IAM) for secure and scalable OCR workflows

Strong work ethic and commitment to quality

Ability to work both independently and collaboratively

Adaptability and eagerness to learn new technologies

Positive and proactive problem-solving mindset

Very good knowledge of English and German , Spanish would be an asset

Our Offer

Long-term career prospects: A secure job in a fast-growing, international company with exciting development opportunities for specialist and management careers

Valuable support: Great team spirit, comprehensive onboarding and a wide range of further training opportunities

Tangible added value: Flexible working hours with the option of mobile working on a daily basis, more than 6 weeks' annual leave (6 weeks' holiday + 2 bank holidays + 1 traditional day + ½ day off for birthdays) and the option of up to 25 days' additional unpaid leave per year

Attractive extras: Kindergarten subsidy, meal allowance, gym pass subsidy and job ticket subsidy as well as an annual health voucher and corporate benefits

Fair environment: Possibility of part-time employment, severely disabled applicants will be given special consideration if equally qualified

In case of any questions please contact Jana Müller (jana.mueller@santander.de).

If you feel you have a passion for Santander and would like to contribute it to the company, then we are looking forward to receiving your application (including cover letter) with your desired salary and your earliest possible starting date.

description:
We help the world run better

At SAP, we enable you to bring out your best. Our company culture is focused on collaboration and a shared passion to help the world run better. How? We focus every day on building the foundation for tomorrow and creating a workplace that embraces differences, values flexibility, and is aligned to our purpose-driven and future-focused work. We offer a highly collaborative, caring team environment with a strong focus on learning and development, recognition for your individual contributions, and a variety of benefit options for you to choose from.

YOUR FUTURE ROLE

At SAP Customer Innovation Services, we are not just about solutions; we are about transforming businesses. Our mission is to innovate alongside our customers, creating cloud-based application extensions that meet unique needs and drive growth. As a key member of our team, you will play an instrumental role in this innovative journey.

As a **Cloud Solution Architect**, you will collaborate with our service sales units across Middle and Eastern Europe (including Germany) and support the whole process from deal closure to successful project delivery.

We are on the lookout for an experienced professional (f/m) who is passionate about innovations for industries such as manufacturing, automotive, utilities, retail, consumer products, and life sciences.

What You’ll Do:

Support Engaging Workshops: Collaborate with customers to identify needs for innovation and application extensions in an interactive and impactful manner.
Craft Tailored Solutions: Develop compelling solution proposals and effort estimations, working closely with our global development teams to ensure a perfect fit for customer needs.
Present Innovative Designs: Propose and showcase your comprehensive solution designs and architectural frameworks to our strategic clients.
Support delivery of Proof-of-Concepts and innovation showcases

YOUR PROFILE

We are looking for a person with:

A Consulting Background: First experience with the SAP cloud product portfolio and hands-on involvement in multiple projects within one of the targeted industries mentioned above.
Technical Proficiency: Good knowledge of SAP cloud technology stacks, including SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) and SAP ABAP Cloud.
Software Architecture Experience: Experience in application development (ABAP and/or JAVA) and cloud transformation projects that innovate and elevate.
Passion for Emerging Technologies: A strong interest in machine learning and artificial intelligence, enabling innovative solutions.
Good Communication Skills: Strong analytical ability coupled with fluency in German and English, both spoken and written.
Educational Foundation: A degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, or a related field.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Your future Leader - Stefan Hoberger (www.linkedin.com/in/stefan-hoberger-37650110)

Our Cloud Solution Architects are dedicated to empowering strategic customers in their transformational journey to SAP S/4HANA Cloud and unlocking innovative opportunities with SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP). Our team's focus encompasses the following key areas:

Custom Innovations & Extensions: We design tailored innovations and extensions for SAP S/4HANA Cloud that meet the unique needs of our clients.

Innovative Custom Solutions: Our team leverages cutting-edge machine learning and artificial intelligence capabilities on SAP BTP to develop bespoke solutions that drive business value.

Enterprise Architecture Services: We offer expert guidance in enterprise architecture, emphasizing seamless cloud transformation and effective BTP adoption.

Code & Solution Transformation Advisory: We provide strategic advisory services to assist clients in migrating custom code and solutions from existing SAP on-premises installations to SAP S/4HANA Cloud, ensuring a smooth transition.

Join us in shaping the future of cloud solutions and driving innovation for our customers!

Bring out your best

SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.

We win with inclusion

SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better and more equitable world.
SAP is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provide accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com.
For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for the SAP Employee Referral Program, according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. Specific conditions may apply for roles in Vocational Training.

description:
Jobbeschreibung

Als Machine Learning Consultant (all people) erkennst du das enorme Potenzial in der Automatisierung von Dokumentenprozessen - und hilfst uns, dieses Potenzial in produktionsreife KI-Lösungen zu verwandeln.

ML-Systeme mit Impact gestalten: Du entwickelst LLM-gestützte Automatisierungslösungen von der Idee über Prototypen bis hin zur skalierbaren Umsetzung beim Kunden. Dabei gehst du weit über Prompt Engineering hinaus: Du entwirfst agentenbasierte Workflows, orchestrierst komplexe Validierungsprozesse, evaluierst Modellansätze und bringst neue Technologien zum produktiven Einsatz.
Infrastruktur schaffen, die trägt: Du entwickelst Kernkomponenten, Prompt-Frameworks, Dokumentenagenten und Datenpipelines, die zukünftige Deployments schneller, zuverlässiger und intelligenter machen.
Komplexität durchdringen: Du arbeitest eng mit Kunden und Stakeholdern zusammen, analysierst deren Dokumente, Prozesse und Herausforderungen – auch jene, die sich nicht in Standards fassen lassen. Deine Beratung zielt darauf ab, greifbare Mehrwerte zu schaffen und die richtigen technologischen Hebel zu identifizieren.
Technische Richtung mitgestalten: Du erschließt Neuland, erkundest neue Ansätze, bewertest aufkommende Technologien und schaffst Struktur, wo noch Unklarheit herrscht. Du fühlst dich in Unsicherheit nicht nur wohl, sondern blühst darin auf und entwickelst mutige Lösungen, statt vorgefertigten Playbooks zu folgen.
Schnell iterieren, sichtbar liefern: Du arbeitest mit erfahrenen Engineers, Produktmenschen und Fachexperten, mit hoher Eigenverantwortung, schnellen Feedbackschleifen und greifbaren Ergebnissen in wenigen Tagen.

Qualifikationen

Du hast Erfahrung mit OpenAI, Claude, Gemini und/oder Open-Source-Modellen. Du kennst die Feinheiten von Prompting, Fine-Tuning und Evaluation und weißt, wann LLMs das richtige Werkzeug sind.
Du hast ML-basierte Systeme in produktive Umgebungen gebracht, auch in komplexen oder unklaren Situationen.
Du entwickelst wiederverwendbare Komponenten statt Einweg-Skripte. Andere bauen auf deine Libraries, Evaluations-Frameworks und Orchestrierungslogik.
Du schreibst sauberen, gut getesteten Python-Code. CI/CD, Versionskontrolle und Code-Reviews sind für dich selbstverständlich.
Du kombinierst durchdachtes Design mit schneller Umsetzung mit AI-gestütztem Coding und iterativem Prototyping.
Du erklärst komplexe Ideen klar, kannst dich auf unterschiedliche Zielgruppen einstellen und arbeitest gerne interdisziplinär.
Bonuspunkte
5+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von B2B-ML-Lösungen
Erfahrung im direkten Kundenkontakt oder technischer Beratung
Kenntnisse in Vertex AI, Bedrock oder containerisierter Infrastruktur (Docker, Kubernetes)
Erfahrung mit Dokumentenverarbeitung, NLP-intensiven Systemen oder agentischen Workflows

Benefits

Dich erwarten spannende und herausfordernde Projekte, die du zusammen mit einem engagierten, kleinen Team umsetzt.
Freue dich auf ein attraktives Gehaltspaket, das dir Sicherheit und Wertschätzung bietet.
Du hast die Freiheit, deine Aufgaben so zu gestalten, wie es deinen Stärken und Interessen entspricht.
Nutze die Chance, dein Wissen im Bereich Künstliche Intelligenz zu erweitern und so nicht nur deine Zukunft, sondern auch die Unternehmensentwicklung aktiv mitzugestalten.
Flexible Arbeitszeiten im Büro oder ganz bequem von zu Hause aus – du entscheidest, was am besten zu deinem Leben passt.
Dein Arbeitsplatz wird individuell auf dich abgestimmt – ob MacBook, Linux oder Windows, du hast die Wahl.
Du bekommst ein jährliches Fortbildungsbudget von 400 € für Udemy-Kurse, um dein Wissen ständig zu erweitern.
Verbessere deine Sprachkenntnisse durch Deutsch- oder Englischkurse, die dir kostenlos zur Verfügung stehen.

Über uns

Wir bauen die ersten KI-Mitarbeitenden für die Verarbeitung von Logistikdokumenten und automatisieren damit Milliarden von Aufgaben, die globale Lieferketten am Laufen halten. Unsere Systeme verarbeiten bereits heute Dokumenten-Workflows im großen Maßstab für führenden Unternehmen - und wir stehen erst am Anfang dessen, was möglich ist.

Wir suchen außergewöhnliche Talente, die mit uns neu denken, wie Unternehmen komplexe Dokumentenprozesse handhaben. Du arbeitest direkt mit Kunden, die vor echten Herausforderungen stehen, und mit technischen Teams, die mit KI-Automatisierung neue Maßbstäbe setzen. Werde Teil unseres dynamischen Teams von 55 Mitarbeitenden an mehreren Standorten. Bei uns arbeitest du in einem agilen, kreativen Umfeld, das dir die Freiheit gibt, so zu arbeiten, wie es am besten zu dir passt – von zu Hause, hybrid oder aus unseren Büros in Leipzig oder München.

description:
Exasol’s Analytics Engine accelerates insights from the world’s data. It is purpose-built to handle the most demanding data workloads at an unmatched price/performance ratio. Our in-memory, massively parallel processing (MPP) technology is specifically designed for analytics, enabling businesses to turn data into actionable insights.

At Exasol, we are committed to pushing the boundaries of what is possible in data analytics, and we are looking for enthusiastic individuals to join our team and help shape the future of data technology. Join our diverse, remote-first team where more than 30+ languages (and counting!) are spoken, and every voice is valued. We are looking for passionate individuals who thrive on collaboration, innovation, and a shared commitment to help shape the future of data technology.

Overview

We are seeking a C++ Storage Engineer that will be at the forefront of innovation, working hands-on with our cutting-edge parallel storage solution. You will design and implement advanced algorithms, collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate storage functionality, and stay abreast of the latest industry developments. Your expertise in C++, parallel storage technologies, and cloud platforms will be crucial in advancing our storage solutions to new heights.

Responsibilities
Further develop our massively parallel storage solution, ensuring it scales effectively to meet ever-growing data demands while maintaining peak efficiency.
Design and implement intricate algorithms that optimize data management, storage, and retrieval processes, ensuring consistent high performance.
Partner closely with other development teams to guarantee the smooth integration of storage-related functionalities, creating a unified and powerful system.
Leverage your experience of parallel storage technologies to provide valuable insights and drive innovation in our storage solution.
Stay informed on storage technology advancements, continuously learning and exploring new approaches to enhance our solutions.
Rigorously test, debug, and refine the codebase to ensure maximum stability and reliability of our storage solutions.
Required Qualifications
A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
5-7 years of relevant experience in software development, with a focus on storage systems, including experience in building robust, complex software products within a Massively Parallel Processing (MPP) environment.
Strong proficiency in modern C++ programming with a focus on performance optimization.
Familiarity with scripting languages such as Bash and Python for automation and streamlining tasks.
Solid understanding of Linux environments.
Knowledge of parallel storage technologies like HDFS, GlusterFS, Ceph, and RAID algorithms.
Familiarity with public cloud storage solutions across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
Proven expertise in creating efficient and distributed algorithms.
An analytical and structured approach to problem-solving, coupled with a commitment to high-quality code.
Approach challenges with a methodical and logical mindset.
Maintain a strong focus on delivering high-quality code and solutions.
Working proficiency in English.
How We Work at Exasol:
Own Your Impact: At Exasol, you are not just a cog in the machine; you will step into immediate ownership of projects, driving them forward with a refreshing level of autonomy.
Thrive in a Global Team: Join a vibrant, international community where diversity is celebrated, collaboration is key, and feedback fuels growth.
Learn, Grow, Lead: We are invested in your development! Continuous knowledge-sharing, "Coffee and Learn" sessions, exciting events, and dedicated leadership programs empower you to soar.
Work on Your Terms: Flexibility is the name of the game! Enjoy adaptable hours, remote options, and "workcations" for the ultimate work-life balance.
Growth That Goes Beyond the Office: Dive into a comprehensive onboarding experience, fun team events, and a deep commitment to diversity and sustainability. We care about your holistic well-being.
Rewards that Matter: Monthly home office allowance, volunteering options, floating days, and secure pension plans (location-dependent) prove we value your contributions.

Our values drive our unique and inclusive culture; discover how they shape your Exasol experience. Learn more about our core values at Exasol.

About Exasol:

Take the next step in your career journey. Visit www.exasol.com to explore our current job openings, and follow us on LinkedIn to see what it is like to work at Exasol.

Exasol is a proud equal opportunities employer. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive working environment and therefore base all our employment selection decisions, within all aspects of our business, on experience, skill, and integrity. We strongly encourage applicants from all walks to life to apply for our positions, irrespective of age, sex, gender identity, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion, etc.

description:
Über uns

Die appliedAI Initiative unterstützt die europäische Industrie dabei, das KI-Zeitalter mitzugestalten und so eine lebenswerte Zukunft zu schaffen. Durch unser Ökosystem aus starken Partnern, umfassenden Programmen, Dienstleistungen und Lösungen bringen wir Unternehmen auf ihrer KI-Reise ganzheitlich voran. Mit unserem einzigartig diversen, interdisziplinären und engagierten Team bauen wir auf tiefes technisches Fachwissen und spezialisieren uns gleichzeitig auf die Anwendbarkeit der Lösungen. Wir teilen ein Mindset der Zusammenarbeit und Offenheit mit unserem Ökosystem aus führenden Unternehmen und Technologieakteuren. Unser gemeinsames Ziel ist es, die europäische Landschaft zu stärken und gemeinsam einzigartiges Wissen für die Anwendung vertrauenswürdiger KI zu schaffen.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Generative AI Engineer (m/f/x) arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle von KI-Forschung und Softwareentwicklung. Du setzt dein Fachwissen in den Bereichen Generative KI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Deep Learning und Agentensysteme ein, um innovative KI-Anwendungen zu entwickeln. Deine Leidenschaft ist es, Fortschritte in der KI in praxisnahe Lösungen zu überführen, die Innovationen in verschiedensten Branchen vorantreiben. Im AI Engineering Team von appliedAI arbeitest du gemeinsam mit KI-Expert:innen, KI-Strateg:innen und externen Partner:innen daran, wirkungsstarke Prototypen und produktionsreife KI-Lösungen zu schaffen, die echten Mehrwert bieten.

Strategischer Einsatz von Generativer KI und Multi-Agenten-Systemen zur Lösung komplexer geschäftlicher Herausforderungen und zur Beschleunigung der KI-Adoption in unterschiedlichen Branchen
Verantwortung für die Konzeption und Implementierung von RAG-Lösungen, agentenbasierten Workflows und Multi-Agenten-Systemen, die auf spezifische Kundenbedürfnisse zugeschnitten sind
Einhaltung höchster technischer Standards und aktive Mitwirkung an der gemeinsamen Technologieentwicklung innerhalb von appliedAI sowie im gesamten appliedAI Partner-Ökosystem
Überbrückung der Lücke zwischen KI-Forschung und Softwareentwicklung, um ein robustes, skalierbares und effizientes Design von KI-Systemen sicherzustellen
Führende Rolle bei der Nutzung neuester KI-Technologien, wie der Implementierung und Optimierung von LLMs, um Kund:innen einen nachhaltigen Mehrwert zu bieten

Dein Profil

Fundierte Kenntnisse in Machine Learning, Deep Learning und generativen KI-Technologien sowie ein starker akademischer Hintergrund in Data Science, Machine Learning, Mathematik, Physik oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich
Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung in einer vergleichbaren technischen Rolle, in der Softwareentwicklung oder einem verwandten Bereich, mit sehr guten Kenntnissen in Python und GenAI-spezifischen Frameworks wie LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, Azure AI Foundry, Computer Use o.ä.
Sehr gutes Verständnis von Transformer-Architekturen, Embedding-Modellen und Prompt Engineering-Techniken wie Chain of Thoughts sowie erste praktische Erfahrung mit AI-Agenten-Frameworks
Erfahrung mit DevOps- und MLOps-Praktiken, einschließlich Containerisierung, CI/CD und Automatisierung von LLM-Deployments und Optimierungstechniken, sowie Erfahrung mit Cloud-Plattformen wie Microsoft Azure, AWS oder GCP
Ausgeprägte Problemlösungs-, Analyse- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit, effektiv im Team und mit externen Partner:innen zusammenzuarbeiten
Begeisterung für kontinuierliches Lernen, Innovation und die Mitarbeit in leistungsstarken Teams
Erfahrung und Projekterfahrung mit Vision Language Models (VLM) und Open-Source SLMs sind von Vorteil
Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse werden vorausgesetzt

Deine Vorteile

Ein hochqualifiziertes und motiviertes Team von rund 80 Personen ist auf einer spannenden Reise, um die sich rasant entwickelnde europäische KI-Landschaft zu gestalten.

Erlebe das Beste aus beiden Welten mit unserem hybriden Arbeitsmodell: Du kannst wählen, ob du in unserem inspirierenden Büro im IPAI in Heilbronn oder im House of Communication in München arbeiten möchtest – und hast zusätzlich die Möglichkeit, an einigen Tagen pro Woche remote zu arbeiten.
Gestalte die Zukunft mit:Arbeite an einer Vielzahl innovativer Projekte und entwickle neue, originelle Inhalte basierend auf den neuesten Fortschritten in der KI und ihrer Anwendung in Unternehmen.
Freiraum für kreative Ideen: Eine offene Atmosphäre, die dazu ermutigt, Software, Hardware und Prozesse auf neue und experimentelle Weise zu denken.
Die Trendthemen des nächsten Jahrzehnts:Erhalte die Freiheit und das Vertrauen, eigene Initiativen voranzutreiben.
Ein starkes Netzwerk:Werde Teil einer hoch sichtbaren Initiative und knüpfe wertvolle Kontakte zu Start-ups, Partnern und Tech-Unternehmen.
Bleib aktiv: Dank unserer Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft hast du Zugang zu Tausenden von Sporteinrichtungen in ganz Deutschland (und darüber hinaus).
JobRad-Leasing-Option:Nutze die Möglichkeit, dir dein eigenes Dienstrad zu leasen.
Sabbatical-Möglichkeit: Nach drei Jahren Betriebszugehörigkeit kannst du dir eine Auszeit von bis zu drei Monaten nehmen – denn manchmal reichen 30 Urlaubstage nicht aus, um die Schönheit dieser Welt zu entdecken.

Kontakt

Lucas Fernandes - Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist
appliedAI Initiative GmbH, August-Everding-Str. 25, 81671 München

Über uns

Find out more on https://www.appliedai.de/ and https://www.appliedai-institute.de/

description:
WHO WE ARE

Wire is the leading end-to-end encrypted communication platform, trusted by businesses, critical infrastructure providers, and governments worldwide. We prioritise privacy as a fundamental right, delivering the most secure communication experience across various industries. Our cutting-edge encryption technology and robust security measures have made us a trusted partner in the technology, finance, healthcare, and government sectors. If you're passionate about redefining secure communication and want to be part of an innovative team, join us as a Senior Fullstack Software Engineer. Together, let's build a world where privacy and security shape the future of communication.

GENERAL INFORMATION

Employment Type: Permanent

Previous working experience: 7+ years of experience

Working hours: 40 hours/week

Working Location: Berlin/ Germany remote/ France remote

Reports to: Director Engineering

Desired start date: asap

YOUR CHALLENGE AT WIRE

We are forming a new, cross-functional team of Senior Fullstack Engineers and are looking for multiple experts with deep experience in ReactJS and Golang. Your focus area, whether frontend-heavy or backend-centric, may vary depending on your background and interests.

As part of this team, you’ll help redesign, build, and evolve a microservice and micro-frontend architecture for a range of challenges: from multiple authentication flows to consistent, easy-to-use administration panels, you will implement a modular architecture, new APIs, and component deployment models to maximize Wire’s reach in our key markets, enabling our customers to experience the most user-friendly yet highly secure and privacy-aware product available.

Build and maintain end-to-end features across backend services and frontend interfaces using Golang and ReactJS, delivering secure and performant experiences to our users

Design and implement user-facing components and interactions, making collaboration and admin tasks intuitive and delightful in Wire’s enterprise products

Develop scalable server-side components to support advanced enterprise functionality such as SSO, role-based access, and directory integration

Lead the implementation of our new Subscription and Licensing Service, enabling seamless billing, access control, and in-app payments

Collaborate with Product, Design, and Revenue Ops teams to shape user-centric solutions that are scalable, secure, and aligned with business goals

Contribute to Wire’s internal Golang expert group, promoting code quality, knowledge sharing, and adoption of best practices

Architect and evolve services using modular microservice and micro-frontend patterns to enable flexible, maintainable feature delivery

YOUR PROFILE

Expert knowledge in GO (Golang) in a distributed environment

Expert knowledge in Web Interfaces development using ReactJS

7+ years of professional experience in Software Engineering development

Nice to have: Proficiency in Payment, Invoicing, and Marketplace inner working with with Stripe Subscription or equivalent, Mobile Apps payment solutions

Nice to have: Experience in working with Enterprise SSO / Enterprise Directories (OIDC, Ldap, SCIM, RBAC, etc).

Nice to have: Experience with existing JS / TS design systems (MaterialUI, Mantine, etc) to build rich SPAs and an eagerness to build beautiful User Interfaces.

Strong knowledge in API design, gRPC/REST, from service to SDK

Experience working in a cross-functional team

Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to think critically and analytically.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.

Fluent in English

WHY WIRE?

Join a market-proven (>1,000 customers) company and drive Wire to become the worldwide market leader.

Investment in professional development with an annual education budget of €1,000 and access to top-notch learning resources.

30 days of vacation entitlement, allowing you to take well-deserved time off and maintain a healthy work-life balance.

With an Urban Sports Club subscription, stay balanced and mentally and physically healthy!

Work from a beautiful office in the heart of Berlin or Paris or choose a mix of working from anywhere vs. spending selected days together in our office to connect on a personal level

Enjoy fresh breakfast in the office, daily fruits, snacks, free soft drinks, and a nice Barista coffee machine.

Wire is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate on the grounds of gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or race.

If you are a Senior Fullstack Software Engineer with a proven track record of developing in Golang, we encourage you to apply and join our dedicated team at Wire.

CONTACT

Have we caught your interest? Apply here or send your questions to jobs@wire.com

We look forward to hearing from you!

About us

We're building a secure, easy-to-use, and feature-rich communication tool with the latest technologies. We don't just create software — we're also impacting national and international committees. Our research and development occur at our Berlin headquarters and other locations in Europe and the USA, where we embrace diversity and adhere to the strictest data protection standards. We see regulations as a foundation supporting our commitment to secure our customer's communication.

Jobbeschreibung

Wir suchen Menschen wie dich – und wollen gemeinsam mit dir wachsen. Werde Teil unserer modernen und hybriden Arbeitskultur am Standort Gütersloh und genieße die Flexibilität mobil z. B. im Home-Office tätig zu sein.

Bei uns erwartet dich ein Team aus dreizehn datenaffinen Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die mit Neugier und Engagement an innovativen Datenprojekten arbeiten. Wir teilen die Begeisterung für smarte Datennutzung, moderne Technologien und den Anspruch, datengetriebene Entscheidungsprozesse nachhaltig zu verbessern. Um unser wachsendes Team weiter zu stärken, suchen wir dich als Data Analyst – mit frischen Ideen und einem Blick fürs Wesentliche.

Diese Aufgaben erwarten dich
Du berätst unsere Kunden bei der Einführung und Nutzung moderner BI-Lösungen sowie bei der Entwicklung passender Berichtskonzepte
Du verknüpfst und visualisierst Kennzahlen und Daten, um aussagekräftige Reports zu erstellen, die wirklich überzeugen
Du entwickelst automatisierte Laderoutinen und Datenmodelle für unsere zentrale Microsoft SQL-Server Data-Warehouse Umgebung und bringst diese eigenverantwortlich voran
Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Kunden, Partnern und internen Teams zusammen und setzt Kunden- und Projektanforderungen professionell und lösungsorientiert um
Du spezifizierst Anforderungen, erstellst Fachkonzepte und präsentierst diese souverän in Kundenworkshops oder Schulungen
Wen wir uns wünschen
Du hast dein Studium oder deine Ausbildung im Bereich (Wirtschafts-)Informatik erfolgreich abgeschlossen oder verfügst über eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
Du verfügst über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Analyse, Aufbereitung und Visualisierung von Daten
Du kennst dich mit relationalen Datenbanken (z. B. Microsoft SQL-Server) und Data-Warehouse Lösungen bestens aus
Du hast Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Implementierung von BI-Lösungen mit Power BI, und dir macht die Erforschung von Daten mit modernsten Cloud Technologien und Machine Learning Modellen Spaß
Du bringst Projektmanagement Skills mit, um Kundenprojekte zu begleiten, und kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch

Auch wenn du nicht alle unsere Wünsche erfüllst, zögere nicht dich bei uns zu bewerben, denn WEITERENTWICKLUNG unserer Mitarbeitenden wird bei uns großgeschrieben und eröffnet dir in unserem Unternehmen vielfältige Möglichkeiten.

Wer wir sind

Als international agierender IT-Spezialist und Experte für Künstliche Intelligenz und Multi-Cloud Services unterstützt Arvato Systems namhafte Unternehmen bei der Digitalen Transformation. Rund 3.300 Mitarbeitende an weltweit über 25 Standorten stehen für hohes technisches Verständnis, Branchen-Know-how und einen klaren Fokus auf Kundenbedürfnisse. Als Team entwickeln wir innovative IT-Lösungen, bringen unsere Kunden in die Cloud, integrieren digitale Prozesse und übernehmen den Betrieb sowie die Betreuung von IT-Systemen.

Interessiert? Dann bewirb dich über unser Online-Bewerbungsformular mit deinem Lebenslauf und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung. Wir schätzen die unterschiedlichen Perspektiven, die eine vielfältige Belegschaft einbringt. Daher suchen wir aktiv nach Menschen, die unser Unternehmen durch ihre Identität, ihren Hintergrund und ihre persönlichen Erfahrungen bereichern, mit oder ohne Behinderung.
