description:
Bragi was founded in 2013 and launched the world's first Truly Wireless Earphones in 2015 (yes, a whole 12 months before the Airpods...)

Since then, We have evolved from a promising startup to a market-moving creator of innovative technology, opening the new category of Truly Wireless Earphones. Bragi transformed into a software enabler for consumer brands, focusing on scaling its technology after investing more than $90 million in software and AI.

Now we are a leader in the AI headphone space, known for our smart devices that integrate seamlessly into users' lives. With a focus on innovation and user experience, we are driving the evolution of wearable technology.

Senior Product Owner

This is a remote role but you are welcome to join us at our Munich office

What you will do

Drive the development of tomorrow’s AI-powered audio features, either through your own contribution or close collaboration with strategic partners
Develop new customer use cases that span professional productivity (e.g., business, efficiency at work) and consumer enjoyment (e.g., immersive, high-quality audio experiences)
Build and maintain a developer-friendly environment that empowers third-party developers to create and distribute innovative functionality via Bragi’s customer-facing store
Take end-to-end ownership of feature delivery from early-stage ideation to implementation ensuring your team consistently delivers high-impact outcomes
Maintain a well-prioritized backlog aligned with company goals, ensuring a continuous, relevant offering is available to end users
Collaborate with the Product Manager, who defines the product roadmap and business priorities translating these into actionable plans for your scrum team
Act as a delivery lead, creating realistic execution plans based on team capacity, milestones, and clear prioritization
Manage cross-team dependencies, working alongside other Product Owners to ensure alignment and smooth coordination across multiple squads
Monitor progress, surface risks early, and apply Agile principles and tools to drive transparency, predictability, and continuous improvement in your team’s delivery

What you will need

8+ years of hands-on experience in delivering complex, enterprise-level software as a Product Owner or Project Manager, with a demonstrated track record of meeting customer needs in time and quality in a scaled agile setup with several scrum teams
Background in SW development, either Embedded or Mobile. Solid understanding of Agile principles and proven strong methodological experience
Strong leadership and collaboration skills to lead 9–10-member cross-functional teams and peers with excellent communication and interpersonal abilities
Comfortable taking decisions especially in ambiguous scenarios and working autonomously in a remote environment

Nice to have:

Coming from an Embedded, IoT, Wearable industry or a comparable business area
Coming from the audio industry is a big plus
Background in AI, Machine Learning or related fields
If you have worked in a start-up, being a (failed or successful) entrepreneur or have a side-hustle we are even more excited to meet you

What we offer you

A complex project that is exceptionally challenging and will change how audio is consumed forever
Work hand in hand with worldwide known audio brands
A chance to deliver a delightful experience to 25m+ users in the next 12 months (existing base is 7m+)
A flexible Learning & Development program, choose where you want to improve yourself
If you are in Munich and want to come to the office we have the usual start-up goodies (breakfast, lunch, beers, events, quizzes) and all sorts of digital fun if you are remote
10 professional coaching sessions with experts to support your growth
Work from where suits you best with flexible working hours

description:
Wir helfen die Welt zu verbessern

Bei SAP ermöglichen wir es dir, dein Bestes zu geben. Unsere Unternehmenskultur schafft die Voraussetzungen, damit unsere Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter ihr Innovationspotenzial entfalten und gemeinsam bahnbrechende Neuerungen entwickeln können. Wie erreichen wir dieses Ziel? Wir konzentrieren uns jeden Tag darauf, die Zukunft mitzugestalten und einen Arbeitsplatz zu schaffen, an dem Vielfalt und Flexibilität wertgeschätzt werden und der mit unserer Vision und zukunftsorientierten Arbeitsweise im Einklang steht. Wir legen größten Wert auf partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit und gegenseitige Unterstützung im Team sowie auf Lernen und Entwicklung. Persönliche Beiträge werden anerkannt, und du hast die Wahl zwischen verschiedenen Zusatzleistungen.

Alle SAP Standorte in Deutschland wie z.B. Walldorf (bei Mannheim/Heidelberg), Hamburg, Berlin, Ratingen (bei Düsseldorf), Eschborn (bei Frankfurt), Gerlingen (bei Stuttgart), Hallbergmoos (bei München), etc. sind möglich.

DEINE ZUKÜNFTIGEN AUFGABEN

In dieser Tätigkeit arbeitest du in enger Kooperation mit den Kundenteams, den Entwicklungsabteilungen der SAP BTP und unseren Vertriebs-/Presales-Teams, um neue KI-orientierte SAP-Anwendungen und Erweiterungen in der Cloud für unsere Kunden zu entwickeln. Die ständige Weiterentwicklung der BTP erfordert von dir die Bereitschaft zu Agilität, Aufgeschlossenheit und dauerhafter Lernbereitschaft.

Zu deinen Aufgaben werden gehören die:

Durchführung von Kundenworkshops, um die Anforderungen unserer Kunden zu verstehen und mit dem Lösungsportfolio der SAP abzugleichen
Beratung von Kunden für erstklassige SAP-Integrations- und Erweiterungsszenarien
Erstellung, Konfiguration und Implementierung von kundenspezifischen Anforderungen auf Basis der SAP-Standardtechnologien
Durchführung von Tests und Kundenschulungen

Dabei:

Nutzt du die Funktionen der SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP)
Analysierst du die Machbarkeit für neue und geänderte Services
Unterstützt du die Erarbeitung von Lösungsvorschlägen und das Angebotsmanagement
Übernimmst du teilweise die Verantwortung als (Teil-)Projektleiter (w/m/d)

DEIN PROFIL

Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Informationstechnik, (Wirtschafts)-Informatik, (Wirtschafts)-Ingenieurwesen oder ein fachspezifisches Studium
Beratungserfahrung in der SAP-Beratung mit entwicklungsnahen Tätigkeiten, idealerweise erste praktische Erfahrungen mit dem Fokus Machine Learning bzw. Entwicklung im Bereich Machine Learning
Erfahrung in Konzeption einer durchgängigen funktionalen Landschaft und Entwicklung eines durchgängigen Lösungskonzepts, einschließlich funktionaler Integrationspunkte und anwendbarer Standards
Erfahrung in der Integration von SAP-Lösungen sowie der SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP)
Erfahrungen mit SAP S/4HANA , idealerweise auch im Cloud Kontext
Kenntnisse in Programmiersprachen wie z. B. Python, JAVA, JAVA-Script, ABAP
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
Fließende Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
Erfahrung in der Unterstützung von vertrieblichen Anfragen durch Erarbeiten von Lösungskonzepten und Aufwandschätzungen für Projekte
Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit.

LERNE DAS TEAM KENNEN

Unser Consulting-Team, bestehend aus einer Gruppe von Expertinnen und Experten im Technologie-Stack der SAP, ist Teil der Solution-Area Business Technology Plattform (BTP). Wir unterstützen unsere Kunden bei der Konzeption und Optimierung geschäftskritischer Kernprozesse für strategische, wirtschaftliche und technologische Zwecke. Dabei ist die SAP Business Technology Plattform die Schlüsseltechnologie für Geschäftsanwender, um Prozesse und Erlebnisse miteinander zu verknüpfen, die integrierte künstliche Intelligenz (KI) zu nutzen und kontinuierliche Geschäftsinnovationen fortzuführen.

Gib dein Bestes

SAP-Innovationen helfen mehr als vierhunderttausend Kunden weltweit, effizienter zusammenzuarbeiten und Business Insight effektiver zu nutzen. SAP war ursprünglich für seine Führungsrolle in der ERP-Software (Enterprise Resource Planning) bekannt und hat sich zu einem Marktführer für End-to-End-Software für Geschäftsanwendungen und zugehörige Services für Datenbank, Analyse, intelligente Technologien und Erfahrungsmanagement entwickelt. Als Cloud-Unternehmen mit zweihundert Millionen Benutzern und mehr als einhunderttausend Mitarbeitern weltweit sind wir zielgerichtet und zukunftsorientiert, mit einer äußerst kollaborativen Teamethik und Engagement für die persönliche Entwicklung. Unabhängig davon, ob wir globale Branchen, Menschen oder Plattformen miteinander verbinden, stellen wir sicher, dass jede Herausforderung die Lösung erhält, die sie verdient. Bei SAP kannst du dein Bestes geben.

Inklusion führt uns zum Erfolg

In unserer Kultur der Inklusion stehen Gesundheit und Wohlbefinden im Mittelpunkt. Flexible Arbeitsmodelle sorgen dafür, dass sich jede und jeder – unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund – eingebunden fühlt und Bestleistungen erbringen kann. Wir bei SAP sind davon überzeugt, dass wir durch die einzigartigen Fähigkeiten und Qualitäten, die jede und jeder in unser Unternehmen einbringt, stärker werden. Wir investieren in unsere Mitarbeitenden, um ihr Selbstvertrauen zu stärken und ihnen dabei zu helfen, ihr volles Potenzial zu entfalten. Wir setzen auf die Förderung aller Talente, um eine bessere und gerechtere Welt zu schaffen.
SAP ist stolz darauf, als Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit einzustehen und diese aktiv zu fördern. Wir sind den Grundsätzen der Chancengleichheit im Beruf verpflichtet. Für Bewerberinnen und Bewerber mit physischen und/oder psychischen Beeinträchtigungen treffen wir geeignete Vorkehrungen. Wenn Sie an einer Bewerbung bei SAP interessiert sind und beim Navigieren auf unserer Website oder beim Ausfüllen der Bewerbung Unterstützung benötigen, senden Sie eine E-Mail mit Ihrer Anfrage an das Recruiting Operations Team in der jeweiligen Region: Careers@sap.com.
SAP Mitarbeiter:innen: Kandidat:innen können nur für unbefristete Stellen empfohlen werden – weitere Regelungen findet Ihr in der SAP Referral Policy. Für Ausbildungsstellen können spezielle Regelungen Anwendung finden.

positionName: (Senior) Technology-Consultant (w/m/d) - Fokus: SAP BTP und AI

description:
We help the world run better

At SAP, we enable you to bring out your best. Our company culture is focused on collaboration and a shared passion to help the world run better. How? We focus every day on building the foundation for tomorrow and creating a workplace that embraces differences, values flexibility, and is aligned to our purpose-driven and future-focused work. We offer a highly collaborative, caring team environment with a strong focus on learning and development, recognition for your individual contributions, and a variety of benefit options for you to choose from.

The Global Corporate Segment Public Cloud Lead will be responsible for the strategic direction, execution, and expansion of GROW, AI and public cloud business success footprint globally primarily in the Corporate Segment. He/she will be a member of the Corporate Global leadership, this role will oversee a small yet high impact global team while managing dotted-line relationships with regional leaders across GROW and Line of Business CROs. The primary focus will be to scale GROW, AI-driven and public cloud solutions in the Corporate segment, ensuring that the business achieves non-linear growth through both partner-driven and digital sales channels, while fostering a culture of innovation and transformation in alignment with the company’s vision.

What you'll do

This leader will play a pivotal role in enhancing the company’s competitive edge by guiding the integration and market adoption of GROW, AI and public cloud solutions, collaborating cross-functionally, and driving impactful business outcomes in a matrixed, fast-paced, and dynamic environment.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership and Execution:

Lead the global sales & adoption strategy for GROW, AI and public cloud solutions, ensuring the alignment of the roadmap with business objectives and revenue targets, while adapting to diverse regional market dynamics.

Provide strategic guidance and execution direction to regional GROW and Line of Business leaders, ensuring effective deployment of GROW, AI and public cloud solutions for Corporate and guiding them through key transformation initiatives.

Champion the ecosystem to work with the Partner teams to help partners accelerate faster, focusing on demand generation, solution advisory, and revenue retention.

Team Leadership and Development:

Lead, mentor, and manage a high-performance global team, ensuring that they are motivated, aligned, and equipped to meet both short-term sales goals and long-term growth objectives.

Foster a culture of innovation and accountability, empowering teams to think outside the box and execute transformative sales motions across GROW globally, and AI & public cloud for Corporate Segment.

Market and Partner Ecosystem Development:

Lead the integration and promotion of GROW & public cloud solutions through partner ecosystems, focusing on partner-led sales and digital channels, with an emphasis on expanding the company’s footprint in corporate and mid-market segments.

Build and nurture relationships with key decision-makers, executives, and strategic partners to accelerate growth, ensuring a partner-first mindset and enabling digital transformation for customers.

Stay ahead of market trends, monitor customer needs, and evaluate competitive activities, adjusting strategies to ensure the company’s market leadership in GROW & AI and public cloud services.

Operational Excellence and Performance Monitoring:

Define key performance indicators (KPIs) related to corporate cloud bookings, SAAS offerings expansion, and digital motion impacts, ensuring that all regional leaders are aligned to meet global performance targets.

Report regularly to senior leadership on progress, challenges, and outcomes, adjusting strategies to exceed sales, revenue, and adoption goals.

Leverage data-driven insights to optimize sales processes and ensure the continuous growth and scalability of GROW & AI and public cloud solutions.

Innovation and Transformation:

Inspire and drive bold, innovative thinking, ensuring that GROW & AI and public cloud strategies are constantly evolving to meet emerging market needs and technological trends.

Lead the company’s transformation initiatives, emphasizing non-linear growth strategies that leverage digital sales, automation, and GROW & AI-driven customer engagement.

Champion a culture of continuous improvement, experimenting with new approaches to unlock business potential and create competitive differentiation.

What you bring

15+ years of experience in sales and solution management, with a proven track record in managing global, cross-functional teams and driving growth within GROW & AI, cloud, and SaaS-based business models.

Deep expertise in GROW & AI technologies (machine learning, natural language processing, etc.) and public cloud business applications with an ability to translate these solutions into actionable business strategies.

description:
As a global semiconductor leader in power systems and IoT, we enable game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. That's why you probably use our products every day: smartphone, charger, electric toothbrush, coffee machine, refrigerator, remote control and much more. Would you like to gain valuable practical experience in a global company while you are still studying? Are you open-minded and interested in digitalization, technology trends and innovation and do you like to proactively participate with your own ideas? Then we look forward to receiving your application! We are looking forward to your application!

Job Description

Focus on the future: You help to shape the strategic direction of Infineon IT and gain insights into what the IT organization of the future will look like
Broaden your expertise: You broaden your expertise to efficiently track and support IT initiatives by utilizing a Low-Code platform
Convince with words: You visualize concepts and insights for communication towards different target groups like leadership or technical and functional experts
Stronger together: You support in the continuous improvement of the IT innovation measures
Organizational talent: You develop, prepare and support workshops and gain insights into different facilitation methods
Lifelong learning: You develop your skills in using MS Office (Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel), Out systems (Low-Code Platform), Jira, Confluence and Miro

Your Profile

Study field : You are currently studying business administration, industrial engineering, mechanical engineering, computer science or similar
Work experience: You have already gained some relevant work experience from previous internships, preferably in IT consulting, project management, innovation management
Personality: You are highly motivated and excited about trying out new concepts and technologies
Way of working: You bring along a structured and analytical mode of operation
Skills: You have very good Microsoft Office skills, especially PowerPoint and Excel, knowledge in Low-Code, Confluence and Jira is a plus
Language skills : You have good German and English skills, both written and spoken

Please attach the following documents to your application:

CV in English
Certificate of enrollment at university
Latest grades transcript (not older than 6 months)
High school report

Important information:

Working part-time : The focus is on studies. Therefore, working student is possible during the lecture period with a maximum of 20 hours per week.
Proper students (according to the German law) are welcome : You must be enrolled, and the examination results or modules of your studies must not have been completed yet, so that you can still work in our team for at least 6 months. You must also not be in a semester of leave.
You should live close to the site : It is important for us to work with you on site and to integrate you into the team. You should therefore be able to come to the site regularly.

Contact:
 Julia Flammersberger

Are you in?

With over 1.400 employees worldwide, Infineon IT is the driving power behind the Infineon’s digitalization initiatives.

The Infineon Digital Agenda focuses on the Digital Customer Interface, Digital Products, Digital Services and End-to-End Process Digitalization. IT fosters customer success, utilizes cutting edge technologies and promotes new ways of working in a changing work environment. Operational excellence at benchmark cost in all services provided by IT is the foundation on which all new initiatives are built upon. Cloud Services, Applications, Platforms, Data centers, Networks, Infrastructure, and the entire R&D Computing environment are some examples of the services managed by Infineon IT. Beyond stable and reliable operations, Infineon IT strives for continuous improvement which is based on a core belief of delivering value for our the Infineon business. We play a key role in supporting the Infineon’s key objectives of decarbonization and digitalization.

We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.
This means we embrace diversity and inclusion and welcome everyone for who they are. At Infineon, we offer a working environment characterized by trust, openness, respect and tolerance and are committed to give all applicants and employees equal opportunities. We base our recruiting decisions on the applicant´s experience and skills.
We look forward to receiving your resume, even if you do not entirely meet all the requirements of the job posting.
Please let your recruiter know if they need to pay special attention to something in order to enable your participation in the interview process.

description:
Siegwerk is one of the world’s leading suppliers of Printing Inks and sustainable packaging solutions. A career here will give you significant flexibility and support in a company focused on making a positive impact in the world. Siegwerk is poised to disrupt the global packaging industry; changing the way packaging is produced and consumed for the benefit of us all. At Siegwerk, you will have everything you need to help make that change.

Join us, let’s Do it. With Heart.

Location: Alfred-Keller-Straße 55, 53721 Siegburg

Apply now!

Our benefits - What we offer You:

Flexible working hours, remote work (up to 60%) and 30 days of vacation
Attractive remuneration
Good traffic connections (job ticket available), city center location with restaurants and stores as well as an in-house canteen
Possibility to use a job bike
Access to the global learning platform “Siegwerk Learning Hub” with more than 20,000 online learning modules accessible worldwide as well as online language training with Speexx
External employee consulting ICAS, which supports you with professional and private questions
Free Christmas tree for all employees

You will be working on machine learning and AI related projects for automation of document understanding using various Azure services as well as LLM models. You will use cutting edge technology to develop Agents that communicate and resolve our customer service issues.

You will dig deep in to our enterprise data for gathering insights and communicate it with your team.

Your Tasks - What You can expect as Senior Data Scientist (f/m/d)?

Data Analysis & Pattern Recognition: You analyze company data and production trends to optimize printing ink quality and production efficiency.
Agile Team Collaboration: You will also work closely with your Data Science colleagues (f/m/d) across functions in an international environment.
Stakeholder Management & Presentation Skills: You identify business use cases and present them and new insights to relevant stakeholders and C-level executives.
Development of Predictive Models: You create (AI-based) predictions, implement prototypes and support your colleagues (f/m/d) in interpreting the model results in a business context.
Data-driven Decision-making: Together with the business partners (f/m/d) you implement algorithms and monitor their performance to ensure high customer satisfaction.
Data Science & Machine Learning Trends: You are up-to-date with the latest developments in the field of Data Science & Machine Learning.

Your Profile - What do You bring as Senior Data Scientist (f/m/d)?

Degree: You have a Master's or PhD degree in physics, statistics, business informatics or similar.
Professional experience: You have at least five years of professional experience in a relevant field, ideally in a similar environment such as production, customer segmentation or supply chains.
Technical skills:
You have a sound knowledge of SQL & Python as well as common BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI to implement business reports and BI solutions.
You have expertise in cloud and on-premises storage systems, preferably with MS SQL Server, SAP BW and Azure Storage Services.
You have a very good understanding of business processes and enterprise ERP systems such as SAP ECC/HANA
You have advanced programming skills in languages such as Python & R, especially in the area of AI/ML development.
Analytical & Communication Skills: You are familiar with best practices for analyzing and processing complex data and can communicate the results of potential process optimization scenarios to support business issues in an understandable way, including at management level.
Team Player: You are experienced in agile and cross-functional collaboration in an international environment.
Language Requirements: You are fluent in English and German.

Are you interested?

Should you have any further questions, Sarah Inger looks forward to your call! You can reach her via phone 02241 304 107.

The application deadline is 01.04.2023. Your application can only be considered after this deadline if the decision to fill the position has not yet been made at that time.

50 Jahre nach Gründung des Forschungszentrums Karlsruhe und 181 Jahre nach Gründung der Universität Karlsruhe haben sich die beiden Einrichtungen im Jahr 2006 gemeinsam in der Exzellenzinitiative des Bundes und der Länder durchgesetzt. Im Zentrum des erfolgreichen Antrags stand der in der deutschen Hochschul- und Forschungslandschaft einzigartige Zusammenschluss zum Karlsruher Institut für Technologie (KIT).

Aus historischer Sicht ist diese Pionierleistung nur konsequent, blicken beide Einrichtungen doch auf eine lange Tradition zurück, die nicht nur inhaltliche, sondern auch formale Parallelen aufweist: Beide hatten bei ihrer Gründung Pioniercharakter.
description:
Organisationseinheit

Institut für Industriebetriebslehre und Industrielle Produktion (IIP)

Ihre Aufgaben

Sie möchten die Energiewende mitgestalten und wissenschaftlich begleiten? Dann sind Sie bei uns genau richtig! Sie arbeiten in interdisziplinären Forschungsprojekten, die sich mit der techno-ökonomischen Analyse nachhaltiger Energiesysteme beschäftigen. Ihr Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Sicherstellung der Versorgungssicherheit im Strom- und Gassektor (inklusive Wasserstoff) unter der Berücksichtigung von Extremwettereignissen.

Weiterentwicklung und Anwendung eines integrierten Strom- und Gasnetzmodells

description:
At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.

ABOUT THIS ROLE
The role will drive data-informed decision making for Audible's Content Discovery product team, transforming complex data into actionable insights that enhance how listeners find their next great listen. The position involves collaborating with product managers, engineers, and designers to optimize discovery experiences that delight our customers and grow our business. Using analytical expertise, the ideal candidate will measure success, identify opportunities, and help shape our content discovery strategy in an evolving audio landscape.

ABOUT YOU
You're passionate about using data to solve customer problems and are energized by the challenge of helping millions find content they'll love. You thrive in fast-paced environments, combining analytical rigor with business acumen to deliver insights that drive product decisions. You're a natural collaborator who can translate technical findings into compelling narratives for diverse audiences.

As a Product Analytics Manager, you will...
- Process and analyze datasets to uncover insights that drive improvements to our content discovery experience
- Build and maintain dashboards that track key metrics across the discovery journey and product features
- Partner with product teams to define success metrics and design experiments that evaluate feature performance
- Communicate data insights clearly to cross-functional teams, from engineers to senior leadership
- Develop custom metrics and models that measure the effectiveness of discovery mechanisms

ABOUT AUDIBLE
Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners' imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

Basic Qualifications

- Experience executing intermediate to advanced business analysis using multi-layered SQL queries
- Experience building intermediate to complex business models
- Experience distilling large datasets and translating data into actionable insights for a digital media or eCommerce company
- Experience with data visualization software including Tableau
- Experience working with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with recommendation systems, personalization algorithms, or content discovery optimization
- Experience with Python or R for data analysis and machine learning applications
- Experience with A/B testing and statistical analysis methodologies
- Knowledge of user behavior analytics and engagement metrics
- Experience working in audio, publishing, or entertainment industries
- Intellectual curiosity about what creates value for customers in digital content experiences

description:
Für unsere Abteilung Data & AI am Standort München suchen wir zum 1.10.2025, befristet auf zwei Jahre, einen Werkstudenten (m/w/d) im AI-Engineering in Teilzeit (20h/Woche).

Du liebst Musik? Dann hilf mit, sie zu schützen!

Stell dir eine Zukunft vor, in der Künstliche Intelligenz die Musikindustrie neu gestaltet – und du bist mittendrin. Im AI Hub der GEMA in München hast du die Chance, als Werkstudent:in Teil unseres interdisziplinären Teams zu werden.

Du unterstützt uns bei der Entwicklung von Machine-Learning-Anwendungen und begleitest spannende KI- und Proof-of-Concept-Projekte. Dabei übernimmst du Aufgaben wie Datenanalyse, Modellentwicklung, Integration in Dienste sowie operative Themen wie Cloud-Infrastruktur (Google Cloud) und CI/CD-Pipelines mit GitHub Actions. Auch an der Weiterentwicklung unserer internen KI-Plattform wirst du mitwirken.

Hier spielt die Musik – Dein Einsatzgebiet:
Du analysierst interne Prozesse und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team Ideen, wie wir unsere Automatisierung mithilfe von KI verbessern können.
Du bereitest Daten auf, analysierst sie und schaffst so die Grundlage für leistungsfähige Machine-Learning-Modelle.
Du entwickelst ML-Modelle mit und unterstützt bei ihrer Umsetzung in konkreten Projekten.
Du bringst dich im Software Engineering ein – von der Entwicklung sauberer Python-Codebasis (Clean Code, KISS, Test-driven) über die Einrichtung und Wartung unserer Google Cloud-Infrastruktur bis hin zur Weiterentwicklung unserer internen KI-Plattform.
Stimmig – Deine Qualifikationen:
Du hast bereits Erfahrung in der professionellen Programmierung mit Python.
Du verfügst über ein grundlegendes Verständnis von Machine-Learning- Algorithmen und Datenstrukturen.
Du stehst am Anfang deines Masterstudiums oder hast noch mindestens zwei Semester vor dir.
Du lebst in München oder planst, bald hierher zu ziehen.
Dein Englisch ist verhandlungssicher und dein Deutsch ist wenigstens gut.
Idealerweise hast du erste Erfahrungen mit DevOps-Themen – zum Beispiel mit CI/CD-Tools wie GitHub Actions oder Infrastructure-as-Code-Tools wie Terraform.

description:
We help the world run better

At SAP, we enable you to bring out your best. Our company culture is focused on collaboration and a shared passion to help the world run better. How? We focus every day on building the foundation for tomorrow and creating a workplace that embraces differences, values flexibility, and is aligned to our purpose-driven and future-focused work. We offer a highly collaborative, caring team environment with a strong focus on learning and development, recognition for your individual contributions, and a variety of benefit options for you to choose from.

The Global Corporate Segment Public Cloud Lead will be responsible for the strategic direction, execution, and expansion of GROW, AI and public cloud business success footprint globally primarily in the Corporate Segment. He/she will be a member of the Corporate Global leadership, this role will oversee a small yet high impact global team while managing dotted-line relationships with regional leaders across GROW and Line of Business CROs. The primary focus will be to scale GROW, AI-driven and public cloud solutions in the Corporate segment, ensuring that the business achieves non-linear growth through both partner-driven and digital sales channels, while fostering a culture of innovation and transformation in alignment with the company’s vision.

What you'll do

This leader will play a pivotal role in enhancing the company’s competitive edge by guiding the integration and market adoption of GROW, AI and public cloud solutions, collaborating cross-functionally, and driving impactful business outcomes in a matrixed, fast-paced, and dynamic environment.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership and Execution:

Lead the global sales & adoption strategy for GROW, AI and public cloud solutions, ensuring the alignment of the roadmap with business objectives and revenue targets, while adapting to diverse regional market dynamics.

Provide strategic guidance and execution direction to regional GROW and Line of Business leaders, ensuring effective deployment of GROW, AI and public cloud solutions for Corporate and guiding them through key transformation initiatives.

Champion the ecosystem to work with the Partner teams to help partners accelerate faster, focusing on demand generation, solution advisory, and revenue retention.

Team Leadership and Development:

Lead, mentor, and manage a high-performance global team, ensuring that they are motivated, aligned, and equipped to meet both short-term sales goals and long-term growth objectives.

Foster a culture of innovation and accountability, empowering teams to think outside the box and execute transformative sales motions across GROW globally, and AI & public cloud for Corporate Segment.

Market and Partner Ecosystem Development:

Lead the integration and promotion of GROW & public cloud solutions through partner ecosystems, focusing on partner-led sales and digital channels, with an emphasis on expanding the company’s footprint in corporate and mid-market segments.

Build and nurture relationships with key decision-makers, executives, and strategic partners to accelerate growth, ensuring a partner-first mindset and enabling digital transformation for customers.

Stay ahead of market trends, monitor customer needs, and evaluate competitive activities, adjusting strategies to ensure the company’s market leadership in GROW & AI and public cloud services.

Operational Excellence and Performance Monitoring:

Define key performance indicators (KPIs) related to corporate cloud bookings, SAAS offerings expansion, and digital motion impacts, ensuring that all regional leaders are aligned to meet global performance targets.

Report regularly to senior leadership on progress, challenges, and outcomes, adjusting strategies to exceed sales, revenue, and adoption goals.

Leverage data-driven insights to optimize sales processes and ensure the continuous growth and scalability of GROW & AI and public cloud solutions.

Innovation and Transformation:

Inspire and drive bold, innovative thinking, ensuring that GROW & AI and public cloud strategies are constantly evolving to meet emerging market needs and technological trends.

Lead the company’s transformation initiatives, emphasizing non-linear growth strategies that leverage digital sales, automation, and GROW & AI-driven customer engagement.

Champion a culture of continuous improvement, experimenting with new approaches to unlock business potential and create competitive differentiation.

What you bring

15+ years of experience in sales and solution management, with a proven track record in managing global, cross-functional teams and driving growth within GROW & AI, cloud, and SaaS-based business models.

Deep expertise in GROW & AI technologies (machine learning, natural language processing, etc.) and public cloud business applications with an ability to translate these solutions into actionable business strategies.

Demonstrated success in leading and growing enterprise sales teams in a matrix organization, fostering collaboration across diverse functions, regions, and business units.

Exceptional leadership, mentoring, and people management skills, with the ability to inspire teams to exceed performance expectations and drive transformation.

Strong understanding of the partner ecosystem and expertise in driving partner-led and digital sales motions at scale.

Excellent strategic thinking, problem-solving, and executive communication skills, with the ability to engage C-level executives and key stakeholders effectively.

Proven ability to lead complex, multi-year business transformation projects and manage large-scale GTM execution with measurable outcomes.

Key Competencies:

Visionary Leadership: Ability to create and communicate a compelling future for GROW & AI and public cloud adoption, aligning teams and stakeholders around this vision.

Strategic Execution: Ability to turn strategy into execution, ensuring that global and regional teams are aligned to drive growth and innovation.

Sales Leadership: Expertise in complex solution sales, particularly in GROW & AI, cloud, and SaaS, with a focus on long-cycle, high-value customer relationships.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Proficiency in working across sales, marketing, finance, product development, and partner teams to drive alignment and achieve objectives.

Market and Customer Insight: Deep understanding of market trends, customer needs, and competitive landscapes, with the ability to adapt strategies accordingly.

Operational Excellence: Strong organizational skills with the ability to oversee performance metrics, drive continuous improvement, and ensure resource allocation meets global growth targets.

Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field (MBA or equivalent preferred).

Experience with public cloud platforms, GROW & AI-driven solutions, and SaaS products in a global sales environment.

Familiarity with digital transformation methodologies and frameworks in complex, enterprise sales environments.

Multilingual skills and experience managing global teams across diverse cultures and markets.

Bring out your best

SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.

We win with inclusion

SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better and more equitable world.
SAP is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provide accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com.

Celonis - About us

Celonis makes processes work for people, companies and the planet. The Celonis Process Intelligence Platform uses industry-leading process mining and AI technology and augments it with business context to give customers a living digital twin of their business operation. It’s system-agnostic and without bias, and provides everyone with a common language for understanding and improving businesses. Celonis enables its customers to continuously realize significant value across the top, bottom, and green line. 

Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.


In Nov. 2019 we received our series C funding and won the German Future Award, the most prestigious award in science and innovation given by the German President. With a tremendous revenue growth and an ever-growing global customer and employee base we no longer consider ourselves a start-up. Instead, we retain the dynamic, innovative atmosphere of a young company with the benefits of a mature enterprise. We are passionate about our vision and looking for people who are equally committed to transforming the way modern businesses operate--and having fun while doing it!

Team - Product - Future

These are the three core keywords that make Celonis unique as an employer and differentiate us from competitors such as strategic consultancies, start-ups and IT-software companies.
At Celonis we combine technical market leadership and professionalism with a lot of responsibility, while keeping our start-up mindset. 

Team: 
We at Celonis are a unique team - international, smart, motivated and helpful. We are focused and concentrated at the right moment and master challenges together. At the same time we enjoy our work and laughing is not forbidden. 

Product: 
The Celonis Process Intelligence Platform has landed us as a leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ in 2023 & 2024. In November 2023, Celonis launched the Process Intelligence (PI) Graph, which sits at the heart of the company’s Process Intelligence platform. Using industry-leading process mining technology, the PI Graph builds a system-agnostic digital twin of a business and combines it with the unique business context in which the organization operates (i.e., what makes something “good” or “bad” for the business). It shows how a business is running and where and how it could run better. For the first time, everyone in an organization has a common language to understand how the business operates, gain visibility into untapped value, and be able to capture it.

Future: 
At Celonis we are pioneers and first movers. We do not shy away from any challenge, work with foresight, master challenges and look positively into the future.

Care to join us?
description:
We're Celonis, the global leader in Process Mining technology and one of the world's fastest-growing SaaS firms. We believe there is a massive opportunity to unlock productivity by placing data and intelligence at the core of business processes - and for that, we need you to join us.

The Team

Celonis AI Group (CeloAI) is dedicated to developing state-of-the-art AI/ML technologies for Celonis products and empower enterprises and institutions to make intelligent business decisions and achieve operational excellence. Our dual mission focuses on both the immediate term goals of designing and implementing advanced AI/ML product features and solutions for our customers and the long term goals of establishing competitive advantages of Celonis Process Intelligence platform.

We are a global organization with presence in both Germany and the US. CeloAI Germany has its presence in Munich, Darmstadt, and Aachen.

The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer on the AI/ML Infrastructure team, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and deploying the infrastructure that supports our AI/ML/LLM initiatives. You will collaborate with software engineers, machine learning engineers, and platform infrastructure engineers to deliver scalable and high-quality solutions.

You will be responsible for architecting and implementing robust technical components that drive the next generation of Process Intelligence. These components will leverage technologies such as computer vision, natural language processing, data mining, recommendation systems, knowledge bases, and business intelligence.

The work you'll do
Understand and translate business and technical requirements into effective solutions.
Design and develop highly scalable and performant systems.
Build and maintain low-latency infrastructure for serving AI/ML/LLM models.
Develop intelligent techniques for integrating and processing large-scale enterprise operational data.
Create and maintain APIs, libraries, and infrastructure to support data serving at scale.
Implement data quality and freshness mechanisms for enterprise customers.
The qualifications you need
5+ years of experience in software engineering or a relevant technical role (preferably experienced in Machine Learning Ops)
Expert-level proficiency in Python (preferably experienced with FastAPI, PyDantic, and SQLAlchemy)
Familiarity with distributed systems and event driven architectures (e.g. RabbitMQ or Kafka)
Strong understanding of DevOps principles and tools: Kubernetes, Terraform, DataDog, Docker, CI/CD, ArgoCD
Extensive experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
Proven ability to design, build, document, and distribute scalable services, libraries, and tools
Passion for developing AI/ML/LLM solutions and staying up-to-date with industry trends.

What Celonis Can Offer You:

Pioneer Innovation: Work with the leading, award-winning process mining technology, shaping the future of business.
Accelerate Your Growth: Benefit from clear career paths, internal mobility, a dedicated learning program, and mentorship opportunities.
Receive Exceptional Benefits: Including generous PTO, hybrid working options, company equity (RSUs), comprehensive benefits, extensive parental leave, dedicated volunteer days, and much more.
Prioritize Your Well-being: Access to resources such as gym subsidies, counseling, and well-being programs.
Connect and Belong: Find community and support through dedicated inclusion and belonging programs.
Make Meaningful Impact: Be part of a company driven by strong values that guide everything we do: Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future.
Collaborate Globally: Join a dynamic, international team of talented individuals.
Empowered Environment: Contribute your ideas in an open culture with autonomous teams.

It's system-agnostic and without bias, and provides everyone with a common language for understanding and improving businesses. Celonis enables its customers to continuously realize significant value across the top, bottom, and green line. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Ob im dm-Markt, der dm-Logistik, dem dm-Unternehmenssitz oder bei unserer IT-Tochter dmTECH: Wir stellen die Menschen in den Mittelpunkt und helfen Dir dabei, Deine Stärken zu entfalten.
description:
Einleitungstext
Bei dm und dmTECH sind wir der Überzeugung, dass die Digitalisierung unsere Welt und unser Kaufverhalten verändert. Dabei spielt künstliche Intelligenz eine wichtige Rolle. Schon heute setzen wir auf modernste Technologien, um intelligente Lösungen zu entwickeln. Hierfür suchen wir lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeiten mit analytischem und mathematischem Denkvermögen sowie Leidenschaft für innovative Technologien. Das klingt nach Dir? Dann lass uns gemeinsam handeln – mit Deinem dualen Studium Data Science und Künstliche Intelligenz (B. Sc.) bei dem Ressort M+B in den Bereichen Marketing, Sortimente und Digitales oder unserer IT-Tochter dmTECH. Deine Aufgaben und Lerninhalte
Künstliche Intelligenz verstehen und einsetzen: Du lernst, unsere Anwendungen „lernfähig“ zu machen, damit wir Daten richtig interpretieren und einen Mehrwert für unsere Kunden daraus entwickeln können.
Big Data und Machine Learning nutzen: Du erwirbst Kenntnisse über die Verarbeitung und Visualisierung riesiger Datenmengen sowie die mathematischen Grundlagen des maschinellen Lernens.
Konzepte entwickeln: Du erwirbst die notwendigen Kenntnisse, um neue Konzepte für Anwendungssoftware zu erstellen. Durch das Aneignen verschiedener Programmiersprachen kannst Du Skripte oder Software, zum Beispiel für den Online-Shop, für Apps oder Kassen- und andere Anwendungen erstellen .
Eigenverantwortlich arbeiten: Du lernst schon frühzeitig, Projekte selbstständig zu initiieren und umzusetzen. Dabei stimmst Du Dich eng mit den Fachabteilungen, mit anderen internen Entwicklungsteams sowie externen Partnern ab.
Theoretisches Wissen erlangen: An der Hochschule erwarten Dich spannende Vorlesungen zu Themen wie Data Engineering, Cloud Computing und Big Data oder Process Mining.
Vorpraktikum ab September 2026: Als optimale Vorbereitung auf Dein duales Studium bei dmTECH starten wir bereits vor dem offiziellen Studienbeginn mit einem Einführungsmonat. Dabei erhältst Du einen ersten Einblick in verschiedene Themen und bearbeitest gemeinsam mit anderen dual Studierenden eigenverantwortlich ein Projekt. Im Ressort Marketing + Beschaffung startet Dein Studium mit einem Vorpraktikum in einem dm-Markt. Rahmenbedingungen
Dauer des Studiums
3 Jahre
Ausbildungsorte
Der dm-Unternehmenssitz in Karlsruhe mit Schwerpunkt im Unternehmensbereich Marketing + Beschaffung oder bei der dm-Tochtergesellschaft dmTECH
Die Duale Hochschule Baden-Württemberg in Karlsruhe
Schulische Voraussetzungen
Gute allgemeine bzw. fachgebundene Hochschulreife, gute Fachhochschulreife mit bestandenem allgemeinem Studierfähigkeitstest (Deltaprüfung) oder eine besondere Qualifizierung von Berufstätigen mit bestandenem Eignungstest Das ist uns wichtig
Für dein Studium bei dm oder dmTECH solltest Du eine große Begeisterung für Mathematik, Logik und Informatik mitbringen. Schulabschluss und Noten sind für die Hochschule wichtig. Aber sie sind nicht alles. Viel wichtiger ist uns, dass wir zueinander passen. Uns interessieren vor allem Deine Persönlichkeit, Deine Stärken und Deine Interessen. Zeig uns in Deiner Bewerbung, wie Du diese bei dm oder dmTECH einbringen möchtest. Deine Perspektiven
Wie es nach Deinem Studium weitergeht? Bei dm und dmTECH gibt es zahlreiche Möglichkeiten. Mit einem abgeschlossenen Studium kannst Du bei uns als Fachexperte in Dein Berufsleben starten und Dich in Deinem Fachgebiet weiterentwickeln. Wir unterstützen Dich auf dem Weg, den Du gehen möchtest.

Mit mehr als 1.000 erfolgreichen Projekten gehört iteratec zu den führenden Experten für digitale Produktinnovation, Software- und Architekturentwicklung sowie digitale Infrastrukturen.

A PROPOS DE NOUS

Nous sommes le premier industriel de la donnée en Europe. Notre métier est de créer, manager et exploiter le patrimoine data de nos clients.

Nous avons la conviction que chaque entreprise peut adopter une démarche innovante de gestion de la donnée et créer des cas d’usage disruptifs en réduisant l'impact écologique et en diminuant la dette technique.

Nous comptons plus de 900 collaborateurs en mission chez nos clients grands comptes dans tout secteur d’activité : banque, assurance, santé, énergie, e-commerce, automobile, luxe, retail, transport, agritech…

MISSIONS PROPOSÉES

Nous recherchons un(e) Architecte Expérimenté(e), passionné(e) par la technologie, pour travailler soit en interne, en collaborant de manière transversale sur divers projets passionnants, soit directement chez nos clients, en étant au cœur de leurs défis numériques.

Si vous souhaitez participer à des projets d’envergure, continuer à apprendre et évoluer dans votre carrière, c’est l’occasion rêvée !

Vous aurez la charge de :

Concevoir, modéliser et évaluer la charge d’implémentation des architectures sécurisées, évolutives, fiables et performantes dans les domaines de la Data et/ou du Digital en situation projet et avant-vente

Réaliser des études comparatives de solutions afin de sélectionner les plus innovantes et adaptées au contexte du projet

Réaliser ou conduire les PoV (Proof of Value) et les PoC (Proof of Concept)

Rédiger le dossier d’architecture technique à travers le High et Low Level Design

Assurer le suivi de la conformité des réalisations projets relatives au dossier d’architecture technique

Veiller au suivi des bonnes pratiques sur l’ensemble du périmètre des réalisations techniques

Mener une démarche d’optimisation des coûts afin de garantir que l’architecture soit à la fois efficace et économique

NOTRE PROFIL IDÉAL

En tant qu’Architecte vous disposez d’une expertise dans au moins un des domaines suivants : Data (modélisation), Digital, DevOps, ML ou Infrastructure (on-premise et/ou cloud).

Cette expertise sera confirmée par la maitrise d’un socle technologique selon le domaine concerné et la spécialité :

Data : Storage (S3, Azure Storage, ADLS, GCS, MinIO…), (No)SQL et Warehousing (Redshift, Synapse, BigQuery, Trino, DataStax, MongoDB, Hive, Impala…), Platform as a Service (Cloudera, Snowflake, Databricks), Integration et Compute (Talend, Dbt, Snaplogic, Spark, Glue…), Streaming et IoT (Kafka/Confluent, Pub/Sub, RabbitMQ, Pulsar, HiveMQ, NomoSense, Event/IoT Hub, ThingBoard…)

Digital : Architecture Microservices ou Microkernel, Modélisation C4, DDD, TDD, Languages et Frameworks (Java, Spring, Node, NestJS, PHP, Symfony, Laravel, Python, Django, Go, Rust…), API Management (Apigee, Kong…)

Machine Learning : Dataiku, Azure ML, SageMaker, VertexIA, Databricks ML, Azure Cognitive Services, ML Framework (TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, …)

SysOps : Landing Zone Design (GCP, AWS, Azure), Gestion de l’authentification et des autorisation (Azure AD, Okta, AWS IAM, GCP IAM, …), Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM, CDM, Ansible, Kubernetes, Hadoop…

DevSecOps : Gestionnaire de version (Gitlab, Github, Bitbucket…), CI/CD (Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Gitlab-CI, Github Actions…), Gestionnaire d’artefact (Artifactory, Nexus, Harbor…), Chiffrement, Gestion de secrets, Scans de sécurité (CVE, SAST, DAST…), Observabilité (ELK, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog…)

Vous avez un esprit d’équipe, êtes proactif(ve) et faites preuve d’une forte capacité d’adaptation.

Vous faites également preuve d’une excellente communication, vous êtes capable de traduire des concepts techniques complexes en termes simples pour les parties prenantes.

Enfin, vous avez la capacité d’intégrer un dispositif fonctionnant suivant la méthodologie Agile.

Diplômé(e) d’une école d’ingénieur ou d’un parcours universitaire technique, vous disposez de 8 ans d’expérience professionnelle minimum dans un contexte data ou digital dont au moins 3 ans en tant qu’architecte confirmé(e).

Company Description

We’re the world’s leading sports technology company, at the intersection between sports, media, and betting. More than 1,700 sports federations, media outlets, betting operators, and consumer platforms across 120 countries rely on our know-how and technology to boost their business.

Job Description

Who we are

VAIX is on a mission to use AI to transform human capability and business opportunity in online gaming. We are a subsidiary of Sportradar, means lots of data to play with.
First to market, we brought Netflix and Spotify to online gaming, and acquired by Sportradar in 2022, we are looking for innovative people to keep us on the forefront of the industry.
Our journey began in online gaming, where we leverage the extraordinarily rich data flows and our deep vertical knowledge of that space to transform entertainment and loyalty. Thanks to our union with Sportradar we can use the industry’s biggest source of data to create products and interfaces that are more dynamic and exciting because they are deeply personalized.

What we do

VAIX creates deeply integrated and powerful corporate AI solutions, enabling B2C operators to utilize the power of machine learning for their customers and operations.
We are building a wide range of Machine Learning algorithms; domain-specific Recommendation engines, human behavior predictive models and Natural Language Processing model.

We are seeking an experienced Product Account Manager – to manage the daily and long term marketing & CRM strategy for our Managed Marketing Services (MMS) Clients.

In this role, you'll be at the forefront of AI-powered marketing, working with cutting-edge technology that's reshaping the gambling industry. As an experienced B2C marketer with a strong background in data and analytics, you'll drive game-changing strategies for B2C operators. You'll be part of a dynamic team owning and delivering marketing performance in a fast-growing business area and are comfortable bringing new ideas to the table.

Reporting to the Head of Marketing Services, you'll collaborate closely with Product, Development, Analytics, Business Development, and Sales teams. Your responsibility will be to work hand-in-hand with MBS clients, managing their Marketing Services and leveraging AI to transform their CRM strategies. This position offers a unique opportunity to blend your marketing expertise with advanced AI tools, directly impacting client success in the evolving landscape of online gaming.

THE CHALLENGE

You will drive sales & sales support for new and existing customers.
You will manage client accounts, with a focus on AI Marketing & CRM services.
Take full ownership of the product and customer relationships and provide operational support for running, monitoring and handling issues on AI-driven products.
Reporting on customers marketing and CRM activities.
Enhance Marketing Services offer by adding new acquisition, retention, and reactivation products to the portfolio.
Stay ahead of market shifts, consumer trends, and competitor strategies, adapting marketing when opportunities emerge.

YOUR PROFILE

Bachelor's degree or higher, preferably in Marketing, Business, or related field.
Proven experience managing full-cycle B2C marketing operations, with B2B exposure as a plus.
Strong background in customer-facing roles such as Account Management, Sales, or Pre-sales.
Proficiency in monitoring, analyzing, and refining marketing strategies for optimal performance.
Experience in Product Management, Project Management, and/or QA.
Proficiency in CRM systems, BI tools, and data analysis techniques.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively convey marketing strategies and product benefits to clients and internal teams.
Proactively identify and address bottlenecks, driving progress and solutions across the organization. Act as a bridge between departments, organizations, and processes to ensure seamless collaboration and efficiency.
Strong "get things done the right way" work ethic.
Eagerness to learn new tools and processes.
Fluency in English and an additional language essential.

OUR OFFER

You’ll be surrounded by enthusiastic sports betting and igaming industry experts, this is a chance to turn your passion into a career.
Platform to gain international recognition for your expertise and build a career in one of the fastest-growing businesses in the digital sports environment.
We equip you with competent hands-on managers who are top performers in their field and have a passion for the industry.
We are a diverse and collaborative global team with a unique spirit, determined to achieve our goals with integrity and focus.
We talk sports every day and take the sporting spirit into our daily work.
Work from our Central office, participate in regular team and office social events, and thrive in a hybrid work setup.

Location

Dingolfinger Straße 4, München , Germany

description:
Feste Anstellung, unbefristet

Fordere bei AIXTRON die Zukunft heraus. Challenge the impossible - are you ready?

Bei AIXTRON, dem führenden Anbieter von Depositionsanlagen für die Halbleiterindustrie, schaffen wir nicht nur Technologien – wir gestalten die Zukunft. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 1983 zeichnen uns unser Forschergeist und unsere Liebe zum Detail aus. Unsere hochmodernen Anlagen sind das Herzstück vieler High-Tech-Anwendungen, von LED- und Displaytechnologie bis hin zu Energiemanagement, Kommunikation und Vielem mehr. Unsere Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter sind dabei unser größtes Kapital. Mit deinem Talent und deiner Leidenschaft für Technologie kannst auch du bald dazu beitragen, die Grenzen des Möglichen zu erweitern. Bei AIXTRON erwarten dich spannende Projekte, interdisziplinäre Teams und die Chance, an der Spitze der technologischen Entwicklung zu stehen.

Deine Challenge
Konzeption und Aufbau skalierbarer Cloud-Infrastrukturen in Microsoft Azure und Amazon Web Services (AWS) zur Unterstützung moderner Anwendungen, insbesondere im Bereich Künstliche Intelligenz und Datenanalyse.
Optimierung bestehender Cloud-Architekturen hinsichtlich Performance, Kosten, Sicherheit und Automatisierung unter Berücksichtigung von Best Practices und Unternehmensrichtlinien.
Verwaltung und Monitoring von Cloud-Ressourcen zur Sicherstellung eines stabilen, sicheren und hochverfügbaren Betriebs von produktiven Workloads.
Implementierung von Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) mit Tools wie Terraform zur Automatisierung und Standardisierung von Cloud-Deployments in einer Azure und AWS Landing Zone Umgebung.
Beratung von Fachabteilungen und Projektteams bei der Auswahl und Integration geeigneter Cloud-Dienste für KI-Workloads, Datenplattformen und containerisierte Anwendungen.
Sicherstellung von Compliance und Security durch die Umsetzung von Cloud-Governance-Richtlinien, Identity & Access Management (IAM) und Sicherheitsarchitekturen.
Evaluierung neuer Cloud-Technologien und Services zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung der Cloud-Strategie und zur Unterstützung innovativer Geschäftsanforderungen.
Zusammenarbeit mit DevOps- und Data-Teams zur Integration von CI/CD-Pipelines, Machine Learning Workflows und Data Pipelines in die Cloud-Umgebung.

Das bringst du dafür mit
Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung/ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Informationstechnologie oder einer vergleichbaren Ausbildung
Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Verwaltung von Cloud-Infrastrukturen in Azure und AWS.
Fundierte Kenntnisse in Infrastructure-as-Code, idealerweise mit Terraform.
Erfahrung mit Cloud-Security, IAM, Netzwerkarchitekturen und Governance.
Vertraut mit KI-Workloads, Container-Technologien (Docker, Kubernetes) und Data Pipelines.
Praxiswissen in modernen Cloud Analytics- und Datenplattformen, insbesondere im Kontext von Datenintegration, Analyse und KI-Anwendungen.
Analytisches Denken, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Teamfähigkeit.
Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
Persönlich punktest du, indem du deine Leidenschaft für IT-Services, Problemlösungsfähigkeiten, Kommunikationsstärke, Flexibilität, Ergebnisorientierung, Teamplayer-Mentalität und Innovationsfreude hervorhebst.

Was du von uns erwarten darfst
Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Bei uns kannst du deine Arbeitszeiten ohne feste Kernarbeitszeit flexibel gestalten, mobil arbeiten und somit zwischen Büro und Mobile Office wechseln.
Urlaub: Du erhältst standardmäßig 30 Urlaubstage. Diese kannst du jedoch jährlich durch eine Gehaltsumwandlung aufstocken.
Gewinnbeteiligung: Als Mitarbeiter:in hast du die Chance, am Unternehmenserfolg teilzuhaben und von einer Gewinnbeteiligung zu profitieren.
Gesundheit: Wir fördern deine physische und mentale Gesundheit durch z.B. regelmäßige Gesundheitsaktionen.
Weiterentwicklung: Uns ist es wichtig, dass du dich kontinuierlich weiterentwickelst. Sei es durch unsere eigene AIXTRON Academy oder durch individuelle Förderprogramme.
Altersvorsorge und Zusatzversicherungen: Wir unterstützen dich bei deiner Altersvorsorge und bieten Vermögenswirksame Leistungen sowie individuelle Zusatzversicherungen an.
Verpflegung: In unserer firmeneigenen Kantine erwarten dich subventionierte Menüs sowie frische Obstkörbe mit saisonalen Produkten.

Feste Anstellung, unbefristet

Fordere bei AIXTRON die Zukunft heraus. Challenge the impossible - are you ready?

Bei AIXTRON, dem führenden Anbieter von Depositionsanlagen für die Halbleiterindustrie, schaffen wir nicht nur Technologien – wir gestalten die Zukunft. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 1983 zeichnen uns unser Forschergeist und unsere Liebe zum Detail aus. Unsere hochmodernen Anlagen sind das Herzstück vieler High-Tech-Anwendungen, von LED- und Displaytechnologie bis hin zu Energiemanagement, Kommunikation und Vielem mehr. Unsere Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter sind dabei unser größtes Kapital. Mit deinem Talent und deiner Leidenschaft für Technologie kannst auch du bald dazu beitragen, die Grenzen des Möglichen zu erweitern. Bei AIXTRON erwarten dich spannende Projekte, interdisziplinäre Teams und die Chance, an der Spitze der technologischen Entwicklung zu stehen.


Deine Challenge

  • Konzeption und Aufbau skalierbarer Cloud-Infrastrukturen in Microsoft Azure und Amazon Web Services (AWS) zur Unterstützung moderner Anwendungen, insbesondere im Bereich Künstliche Intelligenz und Datenanalyse.
  • Optimierung bestehender Cloud-Architekturen hinsichtlich Performance, Kosten, Sicherheit und Automatisierung unter Berücksichtigung von Best Practices und Unternehmensrichtlinien.
  • Verwaltung und Monitoring von Cloud-Ressourcen zur Sicherstellung eines stabilen, sicheren und hochverfügbaren Betriebs von produktiven Workloads.
  • Implementierung von Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) mit Tools wie Terraform zur Automatisierung und Standardisierung von Cloud-Deployments in einer Azure und AWS Landing Zone Umgebung.
  • Beratung von Fachabteilungen und Projektteams bei der Auswahl und Integration geeigneter Cloud-Dienste für KI-Workloads, Datenplattformen und containerisierte Anwendungen.
  • Sicherstellung von Compliance und Security durch die Umsetzung von Cloud-Governance-Richtlinien, Identity & Access Management (IAM) und Sicherheitsarchitekturen.
  • Evaluierung neuer Cloud-Technologien und Services zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung der Cloud-Strategie und zur Unterstützung innovativer Geschäftsanforderungen.
  • Zusammenarbeit mit DevOps- und Data-Teams zur Integration von CI/CD-Pipelines, Machine Learning Workflows und Data Pipelines in die Cloud-Umgebung.

Das bringst du dafür mit

  • Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung/ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Informationstechnologie oder einer vergleichbaren Ausbildung
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Verwaltung von Cloud-Infrastrukturen in Azure und AWS.
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Infrastructure-as-Code, idealerweise mit Terraform.
  • Erfahrung mit Cloud-Security, IAM, Netzwerkarchitekturen und Governance.
  • Vertraut mit KI-Workloads, Container-Technologien (Docker, Kubernetes) und Data Pipelines.
  • Praxiswissen in modernen Cloud Analytics- und Datenplattformen, insbesondere im Kontext von Datenintegration, Analyse und KI-Anwendungen.
  • Analytisches Denken, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Teamfähigkeit.
  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
  • Persönlich punktest du, indem du deine Leidenschaft für IT-Services, Problemlösungsfähigkeiten, Kommunikationsstärke, Flexibilität, Ergebnisorientierung, Teamplayer-Mentalität und Innovationsfreude hervorhebst.

Was du von uns erwarten darfst

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Bei uns kannst du deine Arbeitszeiten ohne feste Kernarbeitszeit flexibel gestalten, mobil arbeiten und somit zwischen Büro und Mobile Office wechseln.
  • Urlaub: Du erhältst standardmäßig 30 Urlaubstage. Diese kannst du jedoch jährlich durch eine Gehaltsumwandlung aufstocken.
  • Gewinnbeteiligung: Als Mitarbeiter:in hast du die Chance, am Unternehmenserfolg teilzuhaben und von einer Gewinnbeteiligung zu profitieren.
  • Gesundheit: Wir fördern deine physische und mentale Gesundheit durch z.B. regelmäßige Gesundheitsaktionen.
  • Weiterentwicklung: Uns ist es wichtig, dass du dich kontinuierlich weiterentwickelst. Sei es durch unsere eigene AIXTRON Academy oder durch individuelle Förderprogramme.
  • Altersvorsorge und Zusatzversicherungen: Wir unterstützen dich bei deiner Altersvorsorge und bieten Vermögenswirksame Leistungen sowie individuelle Zusatzversicherungen an.
  • Verpflegung: In unserer firmeneigenen Kantine erwarten dich subventionierte Menüs sowie frische Obstkörbe mit saisonalen Produkten.
  • Offene Unternehmenskultur: Wir pflegen eine offene und respektvolle “Duz”-Kultur, die sich über alle Hierarchieebenen erstreckt.
  • Nachhaltigkeit und Mobilität: Wir setzen auf Nachhaltigkeit und bieten E-Ladestationen für PKW und Fahrräder sowie eine gute Verkehrsanbindung mit kostenfreien Parkplätzen an.
  • Mitarbeiter-werben-Mitarbeiter-Programm: Wenn du neue Talente für AIXTRON gewinnst, belohnen wir dich großzügig mit unserem Mitarbeiter-werben-Mitarbeiter-Programm.

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About the team and the role:

Join eBay's dynamic team dedicated to safeguarding our marketplace. We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer who will play a pivotal role in blending data engineering and data analytics expertise to build robust data solutions. Our team is committed to impactful projects that protect against prohibited, restricted, and counterfeit items, encouraging an outstanding and inclusive culture. This role will report directly to the team leader and will have a significant impact on eBay's success by driving data-driven enforcement strategies.

What you will accomplish:

Leverage advanced data analytics techniques to transform complex datasets into actionable insights that drive enforcement strategies.

Architect and implement scalable data pipelines and infrastructure utilizing cutting-edge technologies.

Design and present sophisticated data processing architectures that optimize storage and computational efficiency.

Develop and deploy analytical models that integrate machine learning algorithms to improve detection capabilities.

Conduct comprehensive analyses of user interactions to derive insights for tool optimization and enforcement strategies.

Collaborate with multi-functional teams to identify data requirements and design efficient solutions that align with business objectives.

What you will bring:

Strong experience in analyzing and interpreting data to derive insights that advise business decisions.

Professional experience in software development or data engineering, particularly in designing and developing ETL pipelines.

Proficiency in Python programming and extensive knowledge of SQL for database management.

Experience with big data technologies such as Hadoop, Spark, HDFS, and DBT.

Familiarity with CI/CD processes, linters, and unit testing.

Experience in product analytics and conducting A/B tests is highly desirable.

Please see the Talent Privacy Notice for information regarding how eBay handles your personal data collected when you use the eBay Careers website or apply for a job with eBay.

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

description:
Hey there!

Do you want to apply AI where it truly matters, to build real-world solutions that drive climate impact?
At Enjins, we’re looking for a Lead AI Engineer to help shape the future of our Berlin hub. In this role, you’ll coach a talented team of AI engineers, lead complex ML and GenAI projects from design to deployment, and play a key (and growing) role in defining the growth of our Berlin hub.

Why?

Our mission is to become the leading AI engineering partner for tech scale-ups, trusted by top talent and forward-thinking clients alike. We focus on industries where AI can drive meaningful impact: ClimateTech, Mobility, and Marketplaces.

How?

Since 2018, we've been engineering AI systems with long-term value in mind. We don’t chase hype, we help our clients navigate the evolving AI landscape with clarity and purpose. By applying a software engineering mindset to everything we do, we ensure our solutions are robust, scalable, and production-ready, whether built on ML, LLMs, or agentic architectures.

What? [You'll be doing]

As our Lead AI Engineer, you will be a key technical and strategic leader within Enjins, directly impacting our projects, internal capabilities, and the growth of our Berlin hub. Your responsibilities will include:

Technical Leadership & Hands-on Contribution:

Serve as a technical authority, leading the design, development, and deployment of complex AI/ML/LLM solutions in climate tech, mobility, and marketplaces
Maintain a hands-on approach, actively contributing to code, model development, and architecture design, setting high technical standards
Develop and uphold quality standards across projects (e.g., peer reviews, coding conventions, ML, GenAI and LLMOps best practices)
Oversee and guide our Machine Learning Engineer Acceleration Program (M-Leap) activities within the Berlin hub, ensuring talent development

Team Leadership & Growth:

Lead, mentor, and coach a team of talented AI engineers in the Berlin hub, fostering a collaborative and high-performance environment
Work closely with the Berlin based CCO to build and grow the Berlin team, actively participating in recruitment and onboarding
Inspire and develop our ML engineers, serving as the "go-to" leader for complex AI challenges and driving a robust technical training agenda

AI Strategy & Roadmap Development:

Define and execute the technical AI vision for the Berlin hub, translating Enjins' overall mission into concrete technical strategies and roadmaps
Identify high-value AI opportunities for client engagements, anticipating tech trends and developing strategies to keep Enjins ahead in the Berlin market
Act as a trusted technical strategic advisor for key clients, contributing as a data/ML/LLM architect and technical challenger, focusing on engineering excellence

Hub Development & Ownership:

Bring energy, enthusiasm, and drive to build the Enjins Berlin hub, fostering a strong value-driven culture and community
Contribute to the strategic development of the Berlin office, ensuring its growth aligns with Enjins' overall mission
Manage technical risks, including security, privacy, and compliance relevant to the Berlin hub's operations
Work hand-in-hand with the CCO in pragmatically tackling overarching managerial tasks and activities

Leadership track

From day one, you’ll step into a strategic role that goes beyond engineering as described above. Alongside leading projects and coaching engineers, you’ll contribute to key initiatives like hiring, shaping our technical vision, and refining how we execute impactful AI work.
Over the course of your first 6–12 months, we’ll work closely together to prepare you to take full co-leadership of our Berlin hub. You’ll build toward becoming end-responsible for the hub — with a focus on technical excellence, team growth, and project delivery, while our CCO drives marketing and sales.
You won’t be alone in this journey — you’ll be personally coached by our CEO and supported by the broader Enjins leadership team. Together, we’ll shape a hub that’s known for cutting-edge AI work and meaningful climate impact.

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications

5-8 years of work experience in roles bridging AI and software engineering, ideally in different companies, demonstrating a proven and consistent track record in delivery
Proven experience in leading and managing AI projects and teams
Deep hands-on experience in designing, building, and scaling complex AI systems (e.g., cloud-based AI systems, data-models, MLOps pipelines) on major cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure)
Strong command of development practices and tools: familiarity with DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and agile development processes
Demonstrated ability to anticipate tech trends and develop strategies that keep teams and projects at the forefront of AI innovation
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
A "builder and strategist at heart" – a proactive leader who takes full ownership and is passionate about technical depth, strategic direction and commercial value add
Strong entrepreneurial mindset with a desire to contribute significantly to the growth of the Berlin hub

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on experience delivering end-to-end GenAI solutions, including working with multi-component pipelines (MCPs) and agent-based architectures (Agentic AI)
Experience representing a technical vision externally through events, publications, or partnerships
Ideally, a network that includes other tech leaders, potential partners, customers, and talent relevant for Enjins in Germany
Experience with managing risks related to technology (i.e. security, GDPR, EU AI Act)
Eagerness to be part of a journey focused on building a high-quality AI engineering brand in climate tech and meaningful innovation
Experience working in a start-up environment with a pragmatic, hands-on mentality

Benefits

We’re looking for a leader who is excited about the journey of building a high-quality AI engineering brand focused on climate tech and innovation. Expect freedom in your role, and benefits like:

The chance to make a real impact on climate change through AI
An enthusiastic, ambitious team of AI engineers
The opportunity to directly influence the growth and success of the Berlin hub
A buzzing office at Berlin’s epicenter of AI innovation: The Merantix AI campus.
Daily collaboration with our CCO and other (NL based) leadership team members
The opportunity to become the trusted AI advisor for scale-ups in industries that matter
A customer portfolio consisting of Berlin (and German based) scale-ups and tech leaders
1-on-1 coaching with our founders, plus external coaching if desired and mutually agreed upon
Hybrid working setup, with a team that values in-office collaboration for learning and knowledge sharing
The opportunity to grow your personal branding through events and content
A fun, down-to-earth team full of humor - we promise!

Have we spiked your interest?

Let’s have a talk! In the first meeting you talk directly to our CEO or CCO, so ask everything you want to know. If you want to reach out to us before applying with any questions, drop us an email at work@enjins.com
